jobs.title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

jobs.title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

jobs.title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
jobs.description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

At Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT), we are tasked with fulfilling every customer order in the most intelligent way possible while making sure customers get their orders on time.

You will work alongside more senior Data Engineers, Software Development Engineers, and Applied Scientists to design, build, and operate the data pipelines, models, and warehouses that our products and analytics depend on. You will take well-defined requirements, build a solution, and deliver it on schedule. You will learn the team's data architecture deeply, contribute to its evolution, and grow into an autonomous owner of significant pieces of it.

This role is a great fit for someone who is excited about working with large-scale, complex data, who cares about getting the details right, and who wants to grow under the mentorship of an experienced data engineering team.

Build and optimize physical data models and ETL pipelines for datasets that serve our products and analytics, using Amazon's data platforms (Redshift, EMR, Spark, S3, Hive, etc.)

The Fulfillment Optimization organization owns and operates the artificial intelligence, optimization, and simulation systems that plan and run Amazon's outbound fulfillment network. Description

At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it.

The Process Improvement Specialist leads and develops Customer Delivery Excellence across Amazon's European middle-mile operations, including Sort Centres, cross-docks, and inbound cross-dock nodes, in a cross-functional environment with Operations, Analytics, Transportation, and stakeholders across the Supply Chain.

In this role you will bring proven performance management mechanisms from Amazon's Fulfilment Centres and scale them across the middle mile. You will establish a structured daily performance management cadence that gives operations clear visibility of the metrics that drive on-time, reliable, and cost-efficient delivery, managing the in-process measures that protect customer outcomes before misses occur.

You will define and monitor relevant metrics, connect them to shop-floor processes, and identify opportunities for performance improvement along with corrective and preventive actions. A key focus of this role is driving container fill rate improvement, a priority requested by our network partners, reducing wasted transport capacity and unnecessary cost across the middle mile.

You will provide in-depth data analysis for decision-making, develop projects and initiatives, and present them to senior management at regional level. While we centre on EU, you will own the design and roll-out of your initiatives with the potential to scale globally.

The role requires the ability to communicate and influence at all levels, strong process understanding, and a solid analytical background. You will strive to excel against Amazon's highest standards, increasing customer satisfaction by providing fast, reliable, world-class service. The successful candidate will have strong project management skills, operations management experience, and analytical capability, and will be comfortable facilitating ideas and working from concept to execution.

We are seeking someone with passion for process improvement and program management, and a background in Operations, Transportation, Supply Chain, or Analytics, to join our EU team. You want to find out what we do not know yet and equip your stakeholders with the data to make the right decisions for a superb customer delivery experience.

Please note: This job is advertised for the London office but can be located at any EU Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, or Corporate Office.

Key job responsibilities

- Establish and lead a structured daily performance management cadence across middle-mile nodes, scaling proven Fulfilment Centre mechanisms to Sort Centres and cross-docks.
- Drive container fill rate improvement, reducing under-utilised trucks and volume left on site, as a priority workstream requested by our network partners.
- Act as an ambassador and enabler for our front-line teams, making sure we detect problems ahead of customer impact, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
- Define, monitor, and connect the metrics that drive on-time, reliable, and cost-efficient delivery to shop-floor processes.

- Develop assessments and reports to quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions based on available data.

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team, part of the EU STEP (Supply Chain, Transportation Planning & Operational Excellence) organisation, is the engine of operational excellence across Amazon's fulfilment network. Our mission is to give operations the capabilities, tools, and daily management mechanisms to deliver flawless fulfilment: on time, at speed, and at the lowest possible cost. We build the standards, training, and routines that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight, and our work spans Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, and the wider middle-mile network.

This role takes mechanisms proven in our Fulfilment Centres and extends them across miles, where structured, daily performance management is a big opportunity. You will work with people across many disciplines, some working with physical products on the floor, others analysing data to help the whole business make smart decisions, all focused on getting products to customers even faster than Amazon is already known for.

We are expanding our Industrial Hygiene team and need a talented professional to join our global field team to support our EU and AMET regions. Are you a passionate leader who is practical, business focused and have strong skills in building trust? In this role, you will assess industrial hygiene risk, evaluate the control effectiveness, and educate stakeholders on industrial hygiene programs, risks and impacts. As the industrial hygiene subject matter expert to the field, you will support field-based projects, including designing exposure monitoring strategies. During and after impactful incidents, you will provide technical support for response, post incident investigation, and risk management. You will work collaboratively across matrixed organizations with Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Field Operations, WHS Program Managers, Operations, and Legal. Adaptability, persistence, and ability to influence are essential to success in this role. This role requires travel within EU and AMET (at least 35% of time).

Key job responsibilities

Worldwide Industrial Hygiene (WWIH) supports all Worldwide Amazon Stores (WWAS) business units (BUs) and regions focusing on physical, chemical, and biological health hazards that cause acute and long-term illnesses. Health hazards that impact associates: mold, noise, heat, cold, communicable disease, ionizing radiation (x-rays), non-ionizing radiation (UV, EMF, lasers), chemicals (ASINs, janitorial, manufacturing), pharmaceuticals, indoor/outdoor air quality, illumination, blood borne pathogen, and legionella. The team is comprised professionals that own specific hazard types (e.g. heat, noise) and control systems (e.g. ventilation). As well as professionals that build mechanisms to ensure conformance to industrial hygiene programs (e.g. training, data management systems). The Field team provides tactical support to WHS Field and Operations. Individuals work alone and collaboratively across all verticals depending on the business need. WWIH partners with the business to define risk tolerance, controls, and guide the business on compromises between competing priorities.

They will serve as the formal EAP partner to cross-functional organizations involved in product disposal ban compliance, building trusted relationships that enable excellent outcomes for Amazon and our designated charity partners.

In this role, they will use your expertise to provide insights for enhanced donation management practices while ensuring alignment with EU regulations, product disposal bans, and internal policies. Coverage Strategy: Creates strategies to ensure correct field donations coverage across EU sites, identifying gaps and expansion opportunities.
Technology Integration: Partners with the WW Unsellables team to evaluate emerging technologies, providing EU-specific insights for successful regional implementation.

You evaluate emerging technologies, develop strategies to expand coverage to new sites, and build frameworks that enable scalable growth. When challenges arise, regulatory changes, audit findings, process bottlenecks, you design solutions that strengthen the program.

jobs.description:
Operational Excellence Analyst , Global Operational Excellence

Description

The Operational Excellence Analyst in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) drives data-driven performance improvements across Amazon's EU Inbound Supply Chain operating in a cross-functional environment with Cross Dock and Fulfillment Center Operations, Transportation, Analytics, and Planning Systems teams.

This role owns the technical analysis and automation behind regional Inbound Speed and Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA) metrics. You will build scalable data pipelines, write production-grade SQL against petabyte-scale warehouses, and develop analytical tooling to identify, quantify, and eliminate placement defects, transportation disruptions, and supply chain backlog connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes.

You will develop automated monitoring systems, statistical models, and simulation frameworks to surface improvement opportunities before they impact customers. Your work will span from exploratory data analysis on large-scale datasets to building self-service tools that enable business partners to make data-driven decisions in real time.
The role requires deep technical proficiency in data extraction, transformation, and analysis combined with the ability to translate complex findings into actionable recommendations for senior leadership. You will design and implement end-to-end analytical solutions: from raw data ingestion through insight delivery, working across Andes/Redshift, Athena, S3, Python automation, and visualization platforms.
We are seeking a technically strong specialist with passion for data engineering, process improvement, and operational analytics someone who can independently mine complex datasets, identify systemic patterns, and drive measurable improvements to customer delivery experience across EU marketplace.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the data infrastructure behind Inbound Speed and DEA metric reporting building automated ETL pipelines, scheduled queries, and alerting mechanisms
• Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, query optimization) against large-scale data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) to perform root cause analysis on placement and transportation defects
• Develop Python-based automation for data processing, anomaly detection, and reporting workflows reducing manual intervention and accelerating insight delivery
• Build statistical models to quantify the impact of transportation disruptions, supply chain backlog, and placement deficiencies on customer delivery promises
• Design and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) enabling stakeholders to detect problems ahead of customer impact
• Drive the process improvement roadmap with data-backed proposals influencing decision-making at all levels through rigorous quantitative analysis
• Perform large-scale data mining across multiple database systems (Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB) to identify patterns in transship flows, delivery accuracy, and network performance
• Collaborate with technology teams to translate analytical findings into system requirements, new features, and configuration changes
• Develop and document automated data quality checks and monitoring frameworks for critical operational metrics
• Act as technical enabler for front-line teams building tools that surface defects, identify root causes, and track corrective action effectiveness

A day in the life

• Write and optimize complex SQL queries across multiple data sources to investigate why customer delivery promises were missed —tracing issues back to specific products, warehouses, or shipping routes
• Build and maintain Python scripts that automate daily/weekly data pulls, transformations, and reporting deliverables
• Collaborate with Business Intelligence Engineers, Program Managers, and Finance Analysts to develop scalable metrics frameworks
• Perform deep-dive investigations on specific shipments or orders, then scale findings using statistical methods to quantify network-wide impact
• Translate operational challenges raised by business teams into structured analytical problems — designing technical solutions that address the root cause, not just the symptom
• Partner with tech teams to define data requirements and validate system changes through pre/post analysis
• Present data-driven recommendations to senior leadership with clear quantification of customer and cost impact
• Develop and maintain scheduled data transformation jobs for automated reporting
• Monitor automated alerting systems and triage emerging operational issues using real-time data

About the team

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large-scale data analysis, automation, and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience in ETL management/data pipeline
- Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
- Experience working with operations and business teams to communicate problem impacts and understand business requirements
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
- Experience in data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering within operations/supply chain

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Knowledge of supply chain management concepts - forecasting, planning, sourcing, optimization and logistics or equivalent
- Experience with statistical methods (e.g., A/B Testing, Regression)
- Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration
- Experience in automation or monitoring frameworks, deployment or development
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Master's degree or above in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Python programming experience writing scripts for data manipulation (pandas, numpy), automation (boto3, scheduling), and basic statistical analysis

jobs.description:
Construction Cost Engineering Manager , Cost Engineering, Amazon Global Procurement Organization
Job ID: 10463495 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon builds fast and behind every new Fulfilment Center, Sortation Center, and Delivery Station is a cost estimate that had to be accurate, defensible, and ready when decisions need to be made. We're looking for a Cost Engineering Manager who will deliver construction cost engineering services to Amazon's North America Design & Construction stakeholders producing the estimates, cost models, and analytical outputs that inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's NA infrastructure network.

This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically engaging. You'll deliver a range of estimates across a diverse portfolio of NA building types and project scopes, from multi-site retrofit programs to one-off capital projects, where site conditions, design parameters, and scope ambiguity make every engagement a unique analytical challenge. You'll partner with cross-functional teams from early concept sketches through bid-ready construction documents, combining construction domain expertise with collaborative problem-solving to produce cost intelligence that directly shapes business outcomes.

The core deliverable is construction cost estimates, and the role is within Amazon's Global Procurement Organization, Sourcing Excellence pillar, which means you'll also have the opportunity to expand into broader cost engineering disciplines: should-cost modeling that anchors supplier negotiations, and value engineering initiatives that challenge specifications and drive design-to-cost outcomes. You will work closely with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools daily to accelerate analysis, build scalable costing datasets, and contribute to the development of next-generation automation that multiplies the team's reach.

Key job responsibilities

- Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for NA Design & Construction stakeholders across Amazon's building portfolio: spanning retrofit, expansion, and new-build scopes across multiple building types and network segments
- Develop cost estimates from early-stage concept inputs through RFP-ready construction drawing sets, adapting methodology and analytical depth to available information at each project phase
- Build and maintain programmatic estimating templates for multi-site programs (such as interior renovations, mechanical system replacements) where scope consistency allows template-driven efficiency
- Produce one-off bottom-up estimates for projects where unique site conditions, non-standard design, and scope ambiguity demand deep analytical judgment (such as automation retrofits, site hardening, ad-hoc retrofit requests)
- Generate high-level ROMs for early-stage project exploration when data is limited and design direction is still evolving
- Leverage AI-powered tools as a default part of your workflow; using automation for data gathering, cost benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying expert judgment on complex, ambiguous scopes
- Contribute to the development of scalable AI solutions by curating project data, validating model outputs, and identifying where automation can absorb routine estimation work
- Collaborate with preconstruction managers, design engineers, and category managers to gather site-specific inputs, validate assumptions, and communicate cost risks
- Peer review estimates and cost models produced by teammates to ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with current market pricing
- Maintain and update cost data libraries as required with latest market bids, labor rates, and material pricing to keep cost intelligence grounded in reality
- Over time, expand into should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and value engineering activities on construction projects as part of the broader Cost Engineering services within Sourcing Excellence pillar

About the team

Cost Engineering answers one fundamental question for Amazon: Are we paying the right price? We combine deep technical expertise with advanced analytical methodologies; should-cost modeling, cost estimation, market intelligence, and cost driver decomposition, to deliver transparent, fact-based insights that empower Amazon teams to make decisions with confidence. Our vision is to make cost transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every procurement and business decision reflects what something should cost, not just what the market offers. We cover billions in managed spend across multiple categories globally with exponential growth since the team formation in 2022.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
- Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
- AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow, not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
- Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows: organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

Your primary role will be to tirelessly acquire, qualify and close material sales opportunities for our core platform, digital and ‘as-a-Service' products.  In doing so you will:

• Reach sales targets by initiating and managing sales projects until the conclusion of contracts with new clients;
• For international accounts, contribute to a multi-site sales strategy in partnership with the leading sales executive/manager

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.title: Schulwart:in in Krankenvertretung, Stadtgemeinde Reutte (Hauswart/in/Haustechniker/in)
jobs.description: Einleitung Die Stadtgemeinde Reutte ist menschlich, engagiert und vielfältig – das spiegelt sich tagtäglich in unserem Dienst wider. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden gestalten wir aktiv das Leben der Stadtgemeinde mit und jede und jeder Einzelne macht einen Unterschied. Als einer der größten Dienstgeber der Region bieten wir vielseitige Aufgaben in den Bereichen Verwaltung, Pflege, Infrastruktur und im Bereich Bildung & Jugend. Gemeinsam schaffen wir einen Raum für Innovation, Teamgeist und gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert. Sei auch Du jetzt Teil davon und bewirb dich als Schulwart:in in Krankenvertretung beim Mittelschulverband Reutte über die Stadtgemeinde Reutte. Ihre Aufgaben -Du betreust die MS Königsweg und die MS Untermarkt und sorgst für einen reibungslosen technischen Betrieb. -Die Organisation und Durchführung von Reparaturen sowie die Koordination von Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten bspw. technischer Einrichtungen liegen in deinem Aufgabenbereich. -Auch die Führung und Koordination der Reinigungskräfte stellst du sicher. -Du kümmerst dich um die Pflege der Außenanlagen und unterstützt im Winterdienst bei der Schneeräumung. Zusätzlich übernimmst du Kontrolltätigkeiten, etwa im Brandschutz oder als Liftwart:in. Ihr Profil -eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem technischen oder handwerklichen Beruf, idealerweise mit elektrotechnischen Zusatzkenntnissen (Stark- und/oder Schwachstrom). -mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem verwandten Umfeld und EDV-Grundkenntnisse. handwerkliches und technisches Talent. -die Fähigkeit zum eigenverantwortlichen Arbeiten und zeitliche Flexibilität. Wir bieten Fort- & Weiterbildung: Vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Familie & Beruf: Kostengünstige betriebliche Kinderbetreuung für die ideale Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Job. Kulinarisches Angebot: Ein abwechslungsreiches und preiswertes Essensangebot in der Kantine unseres Seniorenzentrums. Gesundheit & Vergünstigungen: Kostenlose betriebliche Kurse für deine Erholung sowie attraktive Rabatte bei lokalen Partnern wie LUMAGICA oder der Alpentherme Ehrenberg. Sicherheit & Transparenz: Eine sichere Anstellung mit transparenter und fairer Entlohnung nach dem Gemeinde-Vertragsbedienstetengesetz. Das Mindestentgelt beträgt bei Vollzeit monatlich EUR 2.902,70 brutto Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass sich das angeführte Mindestentgelt durch anrechenbare Vordienstzeiten, sowie sonstige mit den Besonderheiten des Arbeitsplatzes verbundene Entgeltbestandteile erhöhen kann. Bist du bereit für deine individuelle sinnstiftende Aufgabe beim Mittelschulverband Reutte über die Stadtgemeinde Reutte? Dann werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und bewirb dich bis zum 23.08.2026 unter: www.reutte.at/karriere Der Verbandsobmann Mag. (FH) Mag. Günter Salchner

jobs.title: Project Manager - BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs, all genders, Österreichische Rundfunksender GmbH (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Help shape the future of media technology!   At BIG BLUE MARBLE, we enable easy access to broadcast content in Austria while driving innovation and customer service in media delivery. Our mission is to actively shape the digital future of TV and radio. By continuously optimizing the media experience for our customers, we provide innovative streaming solutions while pursuing sustainable practices for a climate-friendly broadcasting landscape. To strengthen our Innovation Management team at ORS comm GmbH & Co KG, we are looking for a: Project Manager - Big Blue Marble Labs, all genders Are you passionate about turning innovative ideas into working prototypes and real business impact? Do you enjoy coordinating interdisciplinary teams, working with engineers and product managers, and building a strong innovation ecosystem with partners from industry and academia? If so, join BIG BLUE MARBLE and help shape the future of media technology through our Innovation Lab.  Your responsibilities: Innovation Lab & Proof of Concept Program You will lead the operational activities of the BIG BLUE MARBLE Innovation Lab and coordinate its day-to-day innovation processes. You will organize and facilitate our bi-weekly Proof of Concept (PoC) sprints together with our Full Stack Development team. Together with Product Management, you will evaluate ideas entering the innovation funnel, prioritize opportunities, and initiate new PoCs. You will coordinate PoCs from idea validation to successful completion, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams. You will ensure that all PoCs are properly documented and that their outcomes are transformed into reusable knowledge, technical assets, or follow-up initiatives. You will continuously improve our Innovation Lab processes, fostering an agile and execution-oriented innovation culture. Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships You will represent BIG BLUE MARBLE nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem, engaging with universities, research institutions, public organizations, startups, and technology partners. You will act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation activities and research initiatives. You will represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events while expanding our professional network and visibility. You will contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting the development of new partnerships and innovation opportunities. Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication You will ensure that innovation outcomes are effectively communicated both internally and externally. You will support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination activities. You will prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends. You will promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value. Your skills that inspire us: Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline. At least 5 years of professional experience in Technical Program Management, Product Management, Innovation Labs, R&D, Engineering Management, or a comparable technology-driven role. Experience coordinating interdisciplinary teams and driving Proofs of Concept, prototypes, pilot projects, or technology initiatives from ideas to documented outcomes. Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives across engineering, product management, and business teams. Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration, workshops, or cross-functional planning activities. Solid understanding of modern software development, cloud technologies, AI trends, media technologies, streaming, or digital platforms. You don't need to be a software developer, but you enjoy working closely with technical experts. Experience collaborating with universities, research institutions, startups, public organizations, or technology partners is an advantage. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in national and international innovation networks, conferences, and partner meetings. Experience preparing or contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, presentations, or similar publications is considered a strong asset. You are a proactive, hands-on personality who enjoys bringing structure to innovation activities, connecting people, and turning promising ideas into tangible results. Fluent English (C1/C2) and German (minimum B2) are required. Here's what we're proposing for you: In addition to an annual salary in line with the market, we offer you a package of benefits consisting of a mobility allowance for the Wiener Linien annual ticket or the KLIMATICKET, a company canteen, our bonus programme, the pension fund and a sports programme. Place of work: Vienna (remote option), working hours: 38,5hours per week, reference number: OC1026CINSE, starting date: 08/2026. We are happy to offer professionals with relevant training and experience a gross annual salary in line with the market of between 56,000 and 72,000 euros (salary group 4, Telekom-KV, 38,5 h/week)*. Remote work Good communication and direct cooperation are very important to us. You can work from home, from the modern office or hybrid. In practice, this means that, according to your preferences, you will benefit from working remotely or from an office in Vienna with a great location and a cool atmosphere. We are happy to talk about the details in a meeting.  Travel This position includes occasional national and international business travel, with an expected travel commitment of up to four weeks per year, primarily for conferences, trade fairs, workshops, partner meetings, and industry events. *For legal reasons, we are required to state the minimum salary as per the collective agreement. For this position, it is  EUR 3.523,02 gross/month (Qualification Group 4, Specialist Level, Telekom collective agreement 2026, full-time).  Why join us: You are passionate about media and have a deep understanding of streaming, broadcasting and telecommunication.  With experience in product- or project management and strong communication skills you are a key asset in every team. Analytical skills and the ability to understand complex scenarios and communicate in a management-friendly complete your skillset. jobs.title: POMOĆNIK / POMOĆNICA  U NASTAVI
jobs.employer: MI Udruga roditelja djece i osoba s poteškoćama u razvoju
jobs.description:
Udruga MI, kao poslodavac i pružatelj usluge pomoćnika u nastavi, u svrhu osiguravanja potpore učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u školskoj godini 2026./2027., sukladno Zakonu o osobnoj asistenciji (Narodne novine, broj 71/23) i Pravilniku o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima (Narodne novine, broj 85/24), raspisuje

JAVNI POZIV

ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA na radno mjesto Pomoćnik/ pomočnica u nastavi Broj izvršitelja - 1 Tjedno radno vrijeme - 30 sati tjedno ( 5 sati dnevno )

Mjesto rada: Osnovna škola Dobriše Cesarića , Slavonska ulica 8 , Požega

Poslodavac: Udruga MI, Hrvatskih branitelja 11a, 34000 Požega.

UVJETI

  • punoljetnost i zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi -dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti dostavlja se prije početka rada
  • završena najmanje razina obrazovanja 4.2 HKO-a
  • završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi – dokaz se dostavlja prije početka rada
  • Iznimno, može se odabrati kandidat koji u trenutku prijave nema završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi, uz obvezu završetka programa najkasnije do kraja prvog obrazovnog razdoblja školske godine 2026./2027 , ako na području osnivača odgojno obrazovne ustanove nije moguće zaposliti osobu s ispunjenim uvjetom obrazovanja za pomoćnika u nastavi
  • iznimno, osoba sa završenom razinom obrazovanja 4.1 HKO-a i završenim programom osposobljavanja može biti odabrana ako na području osnivača škole nije moguće zaposliti osobu s najmanje razinom 4.2 HKO-a, pod uvjetima propisanim Zakonom
  • pomoćnik u nastavi ne može pružati potporu članu svoje obitelji,
  • nepostojanje zapreka za rad iz članka 23. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji

OPIS POSLOVA

Pomoćnik u nastavi pruža neposrednu potporu učeniku s teškoćama u razvoju tijekom odgojno-obrazovnoga procesa, s ciljem izjednačavanja mogućnosti i osiguravanja uvjeta za primjereno školovanje. Poslovi, ovisno o individualnim potrebama učenika, mogu obuhvaćati potporu u komunikaciji i socijalnoj uključenosti, kretanju, uzimanju hrane i pića, obavljanju higijenskih potreba, školskim aktivnostima i zadacima, kao i suradnju s učiteljima/nastavnicima, stručnim suradnicima, koordinatorom škole i vršnjacima učenika. Pomoćnik postupa prema programu rada i uputama škole te u skladu s Pravilnikom o pomoćnicima u nastavi i stručnim komunikacijskim posrednicima.

DODATNA ZNANJA I VJEŠTINE

Uvažavanje različitosti, afinitet prema radu s djecom i mladima s teškoćama u razvoju, otvorenost, odgovornost, fleksibilnost, razvijene komunikacijske vještine, sklonost individualnom i timskom radu, organiziranost, pouzdanost, točnost i emocionalna stabilnost.

PRIJAVA I POTREBNA DOKUMENTACIJA

U prijavi je potrebno navesti ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona i e-mail adresu kandidata. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidat prilaže:

1. životopis (vlastoručno potpisan)

2. dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (preslika svjedodžbe, diplome ili potvrde)

3. dokaz o završenom programu obrazovanja odraslih/osposobljavanju za pomoćnika u nastavi, ako ga kandidat već posjeduje; ako ga ne posjeduje, odabrani kandidat mora ga dostaviti prije početka rada

4. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje

5. potvrdu/uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi postupak za kazneno djelo spolnog zlostavljanja i iskorištavanja djeteta iz članka 23. stavka 1. točke 4. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji.

6. uvjerenje o prebivalištu ( ne stariju od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja )

7. potvrda / uvjerenje o završenom programu obrazovanja odraslih ( osposobljavanju) za pomoćnika u nastavi – dostavlja se prije početka rada

Dokumentacija se može dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici, a od odabranog kandidata Udruga može zatražiti uvid u izvornike.

POSTUPAK ODABIRA

Kandidatom prijavljenim na Javni poziv smatra se osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava tražene uvjete. Odabir će se izvršiti uz pomoć stručnih metoda procjene kompetencija i osobina podnositelja prijave.

Kandidat koji je pravodobno dostavio potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima i koji ispunjava uvjete Javnog poziva dužan je pristupiti testiranju.

Obavijest o datumu i vremenu testiranja, kao i sadržaj te način testiranja biti će dostavljeni kandidatima putem e-mail poruke najmanje 3 ( tri) dana prije testiranja. Kandidati su obavezni pristupiti testiranju uz predočenje odgovarajuće osobne isprave za utvrđivanje identiteta. Kandidati koji ne pristupe testiranju smatrati će se da su odustali od prijave.

Udruga MI zadržava pravo ne izvršiti izbor kandidata za pojedino radno mjesto ako se ne utvrdi da prijavljeni kandidati ispunjavaju potrebne uvjete i kompetencije.

ROK I NAČIN PODNOŠENJA PRIJAVE

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave Javnog poziva.

Prijave s dokazima dostavljaju se osobno ili poštom na adresu: Udruga MI, Hrvatskih branitelja 11a, 34000 Požega, s naznakom „PRIJAVA – POMOĆNIK U NASTAVI – OŠ DOBRIŠE CESARIĆA – NE OTVARATI“.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. O rezultatima Javnog poziva kandidati će biti obaviješteni nakon završetka postupka odabira.

ZAŠTITA OSOBNIH PODATAKA

Prijavom na Javni poziv kandidat daje privolu Udruzi MI za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi i priloženoj dokumentaciji isključivo u svrhu provedbe postupka zapošljavanja, u skladu s važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom Javnom pozivu, a imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na osobe ženskog i muškog roda.

za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju

VRSTA UGOVORA: Ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme za školsku godinu 2026./2027.

UVJETI koje mora ispunjavati kandidat/kandidatkinja:

o završeno najmanje četverogodišnje srednjoškolsko obrazovanje

o završen Program obrazovanja za stjecanje djelomične kvalifikacije PUN/SKP, u skladu s novim

propisima, na temelju SZ i SK upisanih u Registar HKO

o PUN ne smije biti roditelj/skrbnik niti drugi član uže obitelji učenika kojem/kojima se pruža potpora

o PUN ne smije biti osoba protiv koje se vodi kazneni postupak ili je pravomoćno suđena za neko od

kaznenih djela

S kandidatom/kandidatkinjom izabranom za PUN za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju sklopit će se pisani Ugovor o radu u trajanju od 1. rujna 2026. godine do 31. kolovoza 2027. godine kojim će se definirati međusobna prava i obveze.

U prijavi na poziv kandidat/kandidatkinja treba navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, datum i mjesto rođenja, adresu stanovanja, mail adresu, broj telefona i mobitela) te sve tražene priloge.

Uz prijavu kandidat/kandidatkinja dužni su priložiti sljedeće dokumente u izvorniku ili preslici:

· dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (presliku diplome ili potvrdu o stečenoj stručnoj spremi),

· dokaz o državljanstvu (presliku odgovarajuće isprave),

· životopis,

· uvjerenje o nekažnjavanju ne starije od 6 mjeseci,

· potvrdu o završenom Programu obrazovanja za stjecanje djelomične kvalifikacije PUN/SKP, u skladu sa novim propisima,

· dokaz o radnom stažu (elektronički zapis radne knjižice Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje) ne starije od 30 dana.

· dokazi o pravu prednosti pri zapošljavanju, ukoliko ostvaruju takva prava

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužne su uz prijavu na javni poziv priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, potvrdu o priznanju statusa iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo prednosti i dokaz da su nezaposlene.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), dužan/a se u prijavi na javni poziv pozvati na to pravo, te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21) uz prijavu na javni poziv dužan/a je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju navedene na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva Hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, sukladno čl. 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03,148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaze potrebne za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju navedene na mrežnoj stranici Ministarstva Hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapošljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“, broj 157/13, 152/14 i 39/18), uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Preslike traženih isprava ne moraju biti ovjerene, a polaznici su prije sklapanja pisanog ugovora dužni dostaviti na uvid izvornik isprava.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće biti razmatrane.

Podnošenjem prijave na javni poziv kandidati daju svoju suglasnost Osnovnoj školi Vladimira Gortana da osobne podatke iz dostavljenih dokumenata prikuplja i obrađuje u svrhu potrebe provedbe izbora kandidata.

Kandidati koji su zainteresirani za zaposlenje u više škola dostavljaju sve dokumente u sve škole a u prijavi trebaju navesti škole po redoslijedu interesa.

Rok za podnošenje pisanih prijava s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz Javnog poziva počinje teći od 17.8.2026. te traje do 25.8.2026.

Prijave se šalju na adresu Škole:

Osnovna škola Vladimira Gortana, 9. rujan 2, 52341 Žminj, s naznakom „Javni poziv za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju“

Radni odnos sa školom će se zasnivati nakon provedenog selekcijskog postupka.

jobs.title: NASTAVNIK/ICA STROJARSKE GRUPE PREDMETA
jobs.description:
Srednja strukovna škola Velika Gorica, Ulica kralja Stjepana Tomaševića 21, Velika Gorica, na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) te prema Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj strukovnoj školi Velika Gorica raspisuje

NATJEČAJ ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA:

- nastavnik strojarske grupe predmeta – 2 izvršitelja/ice, neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, probni rad 6 mjeseci

Mjesto rada: Srednja strukovna škola Velika Gorica, Ul. kralja S. Tomaševića 21,Velika Gorica

Kandidati koji se prijavljuju na natječaj, uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, trebaju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (»Narodne novine» broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23), Zakonu o strukovnom obrazovanju (NN 30/09, 24/10, 22/13, 25/18 i 69/22) i Pravilniku o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu (NN 1/96 i 80/99) te strukovnom kurikulumu.

U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, kontakt podaci (broj telefona/mobitela, e-mail adresa)) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Kandidat je uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu dužan priložiti:

  • životopis,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • potvrdu ili elektronski zapis Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radnopravnom statusu,
  • dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme (diploma, potvrda o pedagoškim kompetencijama),
  • dokaz da ne postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa prema članku 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, odnosno uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv osobe ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana.

Kandidati potrebne dokumente dostavljaju isključivo u neovjerenim preslikama, koje se neće vraćati. Nakon odabira kandidata, a prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu, odabrani kandidat će dostaviti izvornike dokumenata ili ovjerene preslike. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti propisane dokaze o statusu/pravu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pod jednakim uvjetima pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/18, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji koji su objavljeni na web stranici Ministarstva: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na sljedećoj poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se u prijavi pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 49. st. 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji su objavljeni na web stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka broj 2016/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18), svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava uvjete iz natječaja.

Sukladno članku 6., 7. i 11. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj strukovnoj školi Velika Gorica, nakon isteka natječajnog roka za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj čije su prijave potpune, pravodobne te koje ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će proveden selekcijski postupak. Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata provest će razgovor s kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj strukovnoj školi Velika Gorica:

https://ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr/wp-content/uploads/sites/597/2025/02/Pravilnik_o_nacinu_i_postupku_zaposljavanja_u_Srednjoj_strukovnoj_skoli_Velika_Gorica.pdf

Obavijest prijavljenim kandidatima o terminu održavanja razgovora koji će se održati u prostoru Ureda ravnatelja Srednje strukovne škole Velika Gorica bit će objavljen na mrežnoj stranici Škole https://ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr/natjecaji-za-radno-mjesto/ najmanje tri dana prije dana određenog za razgovor s kandidatima.

Za kandidata koji ne pristupi razgovoru smatrat će se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom treba dostaviti na adresu:

1. Srednja strukovna škola Velika Gorica, Ul. kralja Stjepana Tomaševića 21, 10410 Velika Gorica s naznakom «prijava na natječaj» ili

2. Dostavom dokumentacije na e-mail: ured@ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja.

Nepotpune i/ili nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Kandidat je uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu dužan priložiti:

  • životopis,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • potvrdu ili elektronski zapis Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radnopravnom statusu,
  • dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme (diploma, potvrda o pedagoškim kompetencijama),
  • dokaz da ne postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa prema članku 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, odnosno uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv osobe ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana.

Kandidati potrebne dokumente dostavljaju isključivo u neovjerenim preslikama, koje se neće vraćati. Nakon odabira kandidata, a prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu, odabrani kandidat će dostaviti izvornike dokumenata ili ovjerene preslike. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti propisane dokaze o statusu/pravu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pod jednakim uvjetima pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. stavak 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/18, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze iz članka 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji koji su objavljeni na web stranici Ministarstva: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843, a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na sljedećoj poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se u prijavi pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 49. st. 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji su objavljeni na web stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka broj 2016/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18), svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava uvjete iz natječaja.

Sukladno članku 6., 7. i 11. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj strukovnoj školi Velika Gorica, nakon isteka natječajnog roka za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj čije su prijave potpune, pravodobne te koje ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja, bit će proveden selekcijski postupak. Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata provest će razgovor s kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Srednjoj strukovnoj školi Velika Gorica:

https://ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr/wp-content/uploads/sites/597/2025/02/Pravilnik_o_nacinu_i_postupku_zaposljavanja_u_Srednjoj_strukovnoj_skoli_Velika_Gorica.pdf

Obavijest prijavljenim kandidatima o terminu održavanja razgovora koji će se održati u prostoru Ureda ravnatelja Srednje strukovne škole Velika Gorica bit će objavljen na mrežnoj stranici Škole https://ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr/natjecaji-za-radno-mjesto/ najmanje tri dana prije dana određenog za razgovor s kandidatima.

Za kandidata koji ne pristupi razgovoru smatrat će se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom treba dostaviti na adresu:

1. Srednja strukovna škola Velika Gorica, Ul. kralja Stjepana Tomaševića 21, 10410 Velika Gorica s naznakom «prijava na natječaj» ili

2. Dostavom dokumentacije na e-mail: ured@ss-strukovna-velikagorica.skole.hr

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja.

Nepotpune i/ili nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama HZZ-a te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole. Datum objave natječaja je 17.08.2026. godine.

O rezultatima natječaja svi kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem obavijesti na mrežnoj stranici škole.
