Mer enn bilutleie

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den første personen våre kunder møter. Du er med på å forme inntrykket av Sixt og skape kundeopplevelser som kjennetegnes av kvalitet, tilgjengelighet og premium service.

Rollen kombinerer kundebehandling, salg, logistikk og klargjøring. Du vil jobbe tett på både kunder og bilflåte, og være en viktig del av teamet som sørger for at stasjonen leverer på de høye forventningene kundene har til Sixt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer dem, alltid med et mål om å overgå kundens forventninger. Arbeidsoppgaver • Klargjøring og vask av utleiebiler i henhold til våre kvalitetsstandarder • Oversikt og kontroll på skader og service • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg • Yte premium kundeservice i alle situasjoner • Presentasjon og salg av våre produkter og tjenester • Håndtere telefon og e-posthenvendelser • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig bilflåte • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid • Håndtering av tilleggsutstyr som barneseter, skistativ og annet ekstrautstyr Hvem er du? Du trives med mennesker, liker høyt tempo og motiveres av å levere kvalitet i alt du gjør. Du tar initiativ, ser løsninger og forstår betydningen av både de små detaljene og den helhetlige kundeopplevelsen. Vi ser gjerne at du har: • Førerkort klasse B • Plettfri vandel • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter • Gode salgsferdigheter • Evne til å arbeide raskt og nøyaktig, også i en hektisk hverdag • Stor arbeidskapasitet og vilje til å ta i et tak når det trengs • Strukturert arbeidsstil og evne til å håndtere logistikk i et miljø med høyt tempo • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig • Grunnleggende datakunnskaper, gjerne erfaring med Microsoft Office Hvorfor velge Sixt? Hos Sixt blir du en del av et internasjonalt premiummerke med høye ambisjoner. Du får en variert arbeidshverdag, dyktige kolleger som jobber sammen for å levere premium kundeopplevelser hver dag. Vi tilbyr: • En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag • Et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø • Opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter • Verdifull erfaring fra en internasjonal premium-merkevare • Muligheter for videre karriereutvikling internt • Gode karrieremuligheter for den rette kandidaten

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Digital Content & Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Paiblock is a Fintech company that provides secure access to emerging asset classes to qualified investors, and global crypto payment processing solutions to e-commerce

We are looking for a Content & Creative Lead to join our Copenhagen team. In this role, you will take ownership of our visual content production and bring it to life across our site and channels. You will be responsible for our visual look and feel - setting direction for Paiblock and defining how content shows up everywhere our customers meet us.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong marketing understanding with hands-on content execution. You'll own visual content across our website and channels - the standard, the quality, and making sure we set and keep direction. Using the newest AI tools, you'll produce great content at scale while building automated creative workflows.

The position is full-time and based at Paiblock’s Copenhagen Office in Denmark, where you'll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong commercial focus. You'll also have people responsibility, managing subcontractors who support content production.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Content & Creative Production Manager, you will own content production end-to-end - from setting creative direction to getting content live. You’ll take part in defining the visual bar for Paiblock and make sure everything we launch reflects it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking ownership of overall content production and getting content live across our site and channels - email, socials, creative ads, etc.

  • Using the newest AI tools to execute and produce content at scale

  • Owning the delivery of content packages for new products

  • Setting visual and direction for Paiblock

  • Defining how we use our content on our site

  • Building and setting up automated creative workflows

  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors who support content production

  • Pushing our site and channels to the next level in look and feel

  • And so much more

The Ideal Profile

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-driven and knows all about the newest AI content production tools, with a background in content, creative, or marketing roles, preferably within blockchain or digital lifestyle company.

We imagine that you:

  • Have a strong sense of visual direction, and what good looks like

  • Have a marketing understanding

  • Have strongly adopted AI and use the newest tools to execute and produce content

  • Know how to set up automated creative workflows to scale content production

  • Have experience setting visual direction and look and feel across channels

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

You are someone who:

  • Is motivated by ownership and accountability

  • Is ambitious, takes initiative and turns opportunities into clear, structured actions. And executes them.

  • Is creative and obsessive about quality and detail

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong internal relationships

What We Offer

Our people are at the core of our success, and we work in an environment that values ownership, development, and collaboration - where your contributions make a real impact.

  • A full-time, on-site position at our Copenhagen office in Denmark

  • A role with ownership of our content production and visual direction, with direct impact on how Paiblock shows up everywhere

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social, dynamic, and ambitious workplace culture

  • Hands-on responsibility for setting the creative bar and producing content with the newest AI tools

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues

  • A modern, data- and tech-driven workplace where AI and new tools are actively applied

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent, Turku tai Kuhmo
jobs.description:
**Oletko asiakaspalvelun moniosaaja – tai haluatko kasvaa sellaiseksi?**

Tykkäätkö ratkaista ongelmia, kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä ja siitä fiiliksestä, kun asiakkaan asia tulee kerralla kuntoon?

**Saatat olla juuri se tyyppi, jota etsimme DialOk:lle Turkuun tai Kuhmoon!**

Haemme nyt uusia tekijöitä monipuolisiin asiakaspalvelutehtäviin. Tarjolla on **osa-aikaista työtä** (60-120h/kk).

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

DialOk:lla yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Tuotamme monikanavaista asiakaspalvelua useille suomalaisille yrityksille ja julkisen sektorin toimijoille, joten pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden ja tilanteiden parissa.

Palvelet asiakkaita **puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja chatissa**. Tehtäviisi voi asiakkuudesta riippuen kuulua esimerkiksi:

- tilausten ja muiden yhteydenottojen hoitamista

- ajanvarausta

- asiakkaiden neuvontaa ja ongelmien ratkaisemista

- vaihteenhoitoa

- erilaisia back office -tehtäviä.


Työ ei sisällä puhelinmyyntiä.

Meillä onnistumista ei mitata sillä, kuinka nopeasti saat asiakkaan pois linjoilta, vaan sillä, että hänen asiansa tulee hoidettua **ammattimaisesti, ystävällisesti ja mahdollisimman sujuvasti**. Tavoitteemme on yksinkertainen: ensiluokkainen palvelukokemus – kanavasta riippumatta.

**Missä ja milloin töitä tehdään?**

Voit työskennellä viihtyisällä toimistollamme **Turussa tai Kuhmossa**. Kun talo, työtehtävät ja toimintatapamme ovat tulleet tutuiksi, tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös osittaiseen **etätyöhön** perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Työajat sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin **klo 7–18**, mutta vuoroja on tarjolla myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Osa-aikaisilta työntekijöiltä toivomme mahdollisuutta sitoutua vähintään **kahteen työvuoroon viikossa**.

**Millainen tyyppi pärjää meillä?**

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis asiakaspalvelun supersankari ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Tärkeämpää meille on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja aito kiinnostus ihmisten auttamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taito on etu

- positiivista ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- kykyä pitää pää kylmänä myös kiireessä

- selkeää, rauhallista ja ystävällistä puhetyyliä

- hyviä kirjallisia taitoja

- sujuvia tietoteknisiä perustaitoja

- huolellista ja aikaansaavaa työotetta.


**Jos nautit ongelmien ratkaisemisesta, opit nopeasti uusia asioita ja saat energiaa onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista, olet jo pitkällä.**

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

- Tuntipohjaisen palkan (11,73 €) ja kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän

- joustavia työaikajärjestelyjä

- ajanmukaiset työvälineet

- osaavan ja energisen tiimin tuen

- Epassin liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut

- arvokasta kokemusta monikanavaisesta asiakaspalvelusta

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi useiden erilaisten asiakkuuksien parissa

- mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön perehdytyksen jälkeen. Täysin etänä työtä ei voi tehdä.


Ja ennen kaikkea ympärillesi porukan, jonka kanssa töitä tehdään **ammattimaisesti mutta hyvällä fiiliksellä**.

**Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa – laita hakemus tulemaan!**

Kerro meille, kuka olet, miksi asiakaspalvelu kiinnostaa sinua ja miksi juuri sinä sopisit DialOk:lle.

jobs.title: Expert Observabilité - Dynatrace GEN3 (H/F)
jobs.description:
Nous recrutons pour le compte de notre client, un(e) Expert(e) Observabilité pour renforcer une équipe dédiée à l'ingénierie et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles d'une plateforme d'observabilité SaaS, dans le cadre d'une mission de 6 mois renouvelable.

VOS MISSIONS

Spécialisation logs
     - Intégration structurée des logs dans la plateforme : collecte, indexation, exploitation et optimisation des flux
     - Mise en place de mécanismes de corrélation avancée entre logs, traces et métriques pour une vision bout-en-bout
     - Définition et application de règles de gouvernance : standardisation des formats, politiques de rétention, classification des données, gestion des droits d'accès (RBAC)

Observabilité
     - Contribution active aux projets techniques liés à la plateforme, de la conception au déploiement et à l'exploitation
     - Intégration dans des environnements cloud hybrides (on-premise + cloud public : AWS, Azure, GCP)
     - Amélioration continue du cycle de vie de la plateforme selon une approche Observability as Code (intégration des SLO dans les pipelines CI/CD, automatisation des configurations)

Collaboration & Support
     - Accompagnement des équipes DevSecOps dans l'onboarding des applications et des usages
     - Conseil technique et support aux équipes internes pour optimiser l'utilisation de la plateforme
     - Participation à la communauté interne : partage de bonnes pratiques, formation, contribution aux initiatives transverses

PROFIL RECHERCHE

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Kurikka
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
jobs.description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
At NORMAL we are looking for an experienced People Business Partner in Finland who will be an important part of our People Business Partner team. You will be based at our head office in Helsinki but will primarily have activities in stores - in your regions in the country.

**Your role**

As a People Business Partner, you will be the link between our People Development initiatives and the everyday life in our Finnish stores. You will be given a wide range of tasks – from recruitment and onboarding to leadership development and business partnering – all with a focus on developing both people and the organization. You will participate in leadership group meetings and contribute actively to the People agenda.

**Your responsibilities**

· Drive and support recruitment processes primarily at management level

· Be a close sparring partner for the leaders in your regions - also in relation to strengthening our leadership pipeline

· Drive and support onboarding of new employees and managers

· Teach at our internal management training courses and run workshops

· Facilitate leadership development initiatives and ensure that concepts become practice

· Contribute to the development and implementation of People Development activities in everyday life

**Who are you?**

You are an empathetic relationship builder who meets people at eye level, and you are able to create trust and support among both managers and employees. You have a high drive, like to take initiative and do not wait for others to get you started. You think business and people together - and can translate strategic initiatives into concrete actions. You are also ambitious as a sparring partner and not afraid to get involved.

You thrive in an informal culture where there is room for the crazy and quirky while at the same time, we chase results and have big ambitions.

You communicate fluently in Finnish and English.

**We also imagine that you:**

· have years of experience with recruitment and leadership development – preferably from a larger retail organization

· have worked in a leadership role yourself

· can teach and facilitate with impact and energy

· thrive in an environment with pace, growth and many stakeholders

**Who are we?**

The culture at NORMAL is unpretentious, and we meet each other at eye level with the common goal of achieving success and results – while having a lot of fun and running fast. We believe in US more than ME, so we also help each other when things are busy. The employees have a high degree of influence, as we want to create a workplace based on trust and responsibility for the individual.

**Normal offers you:**

An exciting and challenging responsibility in a rapidly growing company. With us, you will become part of a big family, where we are motivated by self-development and our common goal to make Normal the best place possible for both our customers and employees.

Our working environment at NORMAL's Finnish headquarters and stores is youthful, international and fun, and we have a good can-do attitude. The company's values are an important part of our daily lives and thus we offer the opportunity to develop in a supportive work environment.

jobs.title: Personal & Assistant (Multi-Business Operations)
jobs.description:
Looking for a highly organized, trustworthy, proactive, and versatile Personal & Executive Assistant to support both my personal life and the daily operations of my businesses in Finland.

This is not a traditional office job. Every day is different, and the successful candidate should enjoy variety, solving problems, learning new things, and taking initiative. We are looking for someone who can become a long-term, reliable partner whom I can trust to manage responsibilities independently when needed.

The role supports the following businesses:

- SiivousVelhot (Cleaning Company)

- Lentävä Kalakukko (Café, Bar, Accommodation & Gift Shop)

- E-commerce and Website Projects


Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

- Manage my calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.

- Organize business and personal tasks and priorities.

- Handle emails and communicate with customers, suppliers, and business partners.

- Prepare reports, documents, presentations, and other administrative materials.

- Coordinate projects and follow up on ongoing tasks.

- Handle confidential information professionally.


Business Operations

- Assist in the daily operations of all businesses.

- Coordinate suppliers, inventory, orders, and bookings.

- Assist with customer service.

- Help improve internal processes and business organization.

- Take over certain responsibilities when I am unavailable.


Website & Technology Support

- Test websites, mobile applications, and software before launch.

- Report bugs, usability issues, and suggestions for improvement.

- Assist with product listings and website content updates.

- Learn and use new software and digital tools quickly.


Personal Assistance

- Organize my personal appointments, calendar, and daily schedule.

- Assist with daily errands, including weekends when necessary.

- Organize flights, hotels, meetings, and travel arrangements.

- Assist with administrative and personal matters.

- Coordinate family logistics and childcare planning when needed.


Childcare Support

- Occasionally assist in caring for my 18-month-old daughter.

- Previous experience caring for young children is required.

- Patience, responsibility, and a genuine interest in children's wellbeing are essential.


Cleaning & Hospitality Support

These duties are only required during exceptional situations, such as unexpected staff shortages, employee absences, or sudden operational needs.

When needed, you may be asked to assist with:

- Hotel room cleaning.

- Café cleaning.

- Cleaning assignments for SiivousVelhot.

- General housekeeping and maintaining high cleanliness standards.


Philippine Administrative Matters

- Assist with matters involving Philippine government agencies.

- Help organize taxes, permits, registrations, and official documents.

- Coordinate with government offices and service providers when necessary.


Requirements

We are looking for someone who is:

- Highly trustworthy and honest.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Organized and excellent at time management.

- Flexible and adaptable.

- Comfortable performing a wide variety of tasks.

- Experienced in administration or executive assistance.

- Experienced in caring for young children.

- Comfortable learning new software and technology.

- A good communicator with excellent English skills.

- Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage but not required.

- Knowledge of Philippine government procedures is highly preferred.


Driver's License

A valid driver's license (Category B) is required.

The role involves travelling between different business locations when necessary. Having access to your own car is considered an advantage.

What We Offer

- A unique and varied position where no two days are the same.

- Opportunity to work closely with several growing businesses.

- Long-term employment with opportunities to grow together with the company.

- A supportive and trusting working environment where initiative and ideas are appreciated.

jobs.title: Vastaanottovirkailija Kolin hotelleihin
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIEKSA

Hei sinä hotellialan ammattilainen, kuuletko Kolin kutsun? Tule työkaveriksemme iloiseen Pohjois-Karjalaan, keskelle Kolin häikäisevän kaunista kansallismaisemaa.

Haemme vastaanottovirkailijaa Kolin hotelleihin

Break Sokos Hotel Koli sijaitsee kuvankauniissa kansallismaisemassa Kolin vaarojen laella ja Break Sokos Hotel Koli Kylä on Kolin kylän lämminhenkinen sydän. Yhteensä hotelleissa on 209 huonetta, kansallismaisemaan avautuva Koli Relax Spa ja useita ravintoloita.

Haemme nyt asiakaspalvelun sydämensä asiaksi kokevaa hotellialan ammattilaista työskentelemään hotelliemme vastaanotossa. Vastaanotossamme vastaat asiakkaidemme onnistuneesta hotellikokemuksesta niin aamu- kuin iltavuorossakin, arkena ja viikonloppuna. Olet tehokas ja energinen ammattilainen ja nautit asiakkaiden palvelemisesta. Teet työtäsi innostuneesti, positiivisella otteella ja osaat toimia myös paineen alla etkä hätkähdä vaihtelevia tilanteita. Olet sosiaalinen, joustava ja sinulla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu myös kahvilan ja ravintolan avustavat työtehtävät, uniikin maisemakylpylä Koli Relax Span lipunmyynti sekä Koli Safariksen avustavat työtehtävät vuokravälineiden parissa.

Edellytämme sinulta hotellin vastaanottotyön aiempaa kokemusta, vähintään englannin sujuvaa kielitaitoa, anniskelu- ja hygieniapassia ja ajokorttia, aktiivista ja positiivista asennetta sekä osaamista digitalisoituvassa työympäristössä. Eduksi katsomme Opera Cloud-järjestelmän tuntemuksen.

Työtunteja tarjoamme sinulle 60 h / 3 vk ja työsuhde on määräaikainen, työt alkavat 21.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan aiemmin ja työsuhde on voimassa 3.1.2027 saakka.

Monipuolisen työskentely-ympäristön lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja tuemme sinua onnistumaan tehtävässäsi.

Hakuaika päättyy6.9.2026tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten hae jo tänään! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa hotellipäällikkö Noora Väisänen,noora.vaisanen@sok.fi, tai puhelimitse +358 10762 3640 arkisin klo 9–15.

jobs.title: Zámečník kolejových vozidel, Mechanici a opraváři kolejových vozidel
jobs.description:
Místo výkonu práce: Dělnická č.p. 1408/29
Děčín VI-Letná, 405 02  Děčín 2

Jsme ryze česká, rodinná firma s více než stoletou tradicí, umíme revidovat a opravovat nákladní železniční vozy. Děláme to profesionálně, s nadšením, respektem a láskou. Máme zákazníky z celé Evropy. Dokud budou jezdit vlaky, budeme tu taky.
U nás se rychle rozhodujeme, máme přehledné procesy a jasné postupy, umíme naslouchat, reagujeme na podněty, problémy neřešíme. Jsme stabilní, spolehlivý a slušný zaměstnavatel. O svých více než 350 zaměstnanců se staráme, vážíme se svých lidí i lidské práce. I díky tomu rosteme, rozvíjíme se, modernizujeme a daří se nám. U nás platí podání ruky, neslibujeme, co nemůžeme splnit, jednáme na rovinu. Šikovní, ochotní a pracovití kolegové se u nás mají dobře.
Topíme, svítíme, opravujeme. Práci máme nasmlouvanou na několik let dopředu, daří se nám, proto i dnes nabíráme nové kolegy. Rádi mezi nás přijmeme lidi, kteří se nebojí práce. Právě teď oslovujeme ty z vás, kteří věří, že se k nám hodí, mají rádi vlaky a bavilo by je u nás pracovat 5, 10, 15, 20 i více let.
Hledáme totiž šikovné a spolehlivé dělníky pro pracoviště Děčín.

Náplň práce:
Práce při opravě nákladních vlaků - broušení, čištění, tryskání, vrtání, soustružení, demontáž, kontrola, výměna dílů, montáž… jedná se o dělnickou pozici. Hlavní činností RYKO je provádět technickou kontrolu železničních vozů. Budete ten, kdo umí rozebrat jednotlivé části vagónu, zkontrolovat je, opravit nebo vyměnit a poté změřit. Pracujete s úhlovou bruskou, pneu nářadím, gola sadou, autogenem a někteří i se svářečkou. Vaším úkolem bude rozebrat šroubové spoje, odmontovat nebo namontovat díl, umět narovnat plech nebo vyměnit pororošt nebo prkno. Pracujete u nás také s měřidly, měřícími zařízeními a s počítačem. Umíte nejen opravit rozbitou část vozu, ale i vyplnit protokol, namazat nárazník nebo provést zkoušku brzy. Ze zámečníka jsme schopni vychovat paliče, svářeče, brzdaře, lakýrníka, písmomalíře nebo tlakaře. Ze zámečníka se může stát také četař nebo mistr. Pracujete u nás s železničními nákladními vozy a jejich jednotlivými díly v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu od pondělí do pátku.

Požadujeme:
Vzdělání - vyučení výhodou (zámečník, mechanik, strojař, automechanik, instalatér..)
Manuální zručnost
Vhodná pracovní zkušenost, zkušenost s výše uvedenými pracemi
Pečlivost, přesnost a zodpovědnost
Ochota a zájem pracovat a občas chodit na přesčasy (12 hodin/měsíc)

Nabízíme:
• Několikaměsíční zaškolení a zapracování pod vedením zkušených kolegů, kteří u nás dlouhé roky pracují
• Práci na dlouhodobě nasmlouvaných zakázkách, stabilní, rodinné prostředí a lidský přístup
• Práci v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu (ranní a odpolední směny), Po - Pá, občas • So, neděle vždy volné.

Termín nástupu: dohodou

Mzdové podmínky:
• Mzda má fixní a variabilní složku, která je závislá na výkonu, každý potřebný přesčas platíme a za nadstandartní počty přesčasových hodin jsou zvláštní bonusy
• Výše nástupní mzdy dle znalostí a zkušenostní, konkrétní mzdové podmínky pro nástup, období zapracování a možnosti růstu vysvětlíme u pohovoru

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
• 5 týdnů dovolené
• Možnost stravování v závodní jídelně s příspěvkem
• Pracovní oblečení + jeho údržbu

• Zvýhodněný telefonní tarif

• Náborový příspěvek 10 000

jobs.title: General Merchandise Department Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary...The General Merchandise Department Manager at Walmart plays a key leadership role in delivering a great customer experience by keeping the sales floor stocked, organized, and ready for business. This role leads and supports associates in completing handheld tasks, maintaining merchandise standards, and assisting customers with their shopping needs. By actively planning and prioritizing work based on workload and customer traffic, the Department Manager drives strong execution, teamwork, and resultsâwhile ensuring a safe, clean, and high energy store environment.

What You'll Do...

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver An Excellent Customer Experience

Provides friendly and professional customer service by greeting customers, assisting with product selection, promoting products and services, helping locate merchandise, supporting purchase decisions, and resolving concerns or referring them as appropriate.

Execute Daily Merchandising and Availability Tasks

Delegates, supports, and follows up on the completion of Customer Availability Process tasks, including section work, capping bins, and stocking picks.

Price Changes, Features, and Modular Execution

Delegates, supports, and follows up on the completion of price changes, feature sets, and modulars within assigned areas to maintain merchandise accuracy and presentation standards.

Sales Floor Coverage and Recovery

Assigns associates to support coverage as needed across the sales floor and provides support with recovery and zoning activities to keep the store customer-ready.

Associate Scheduling and Break Coverage

Ensures associate breaks are taken in accordance with coverage requirements to support smooth operations.

Associate Training and Coaching

Provides training, coaching, and ongoing feedback to associates to support performance, development, and engagement.

Safety, Cleanliness, and Compliance

Maintains a safe, clean, and hazard-free work environment by following Company policies and procedures, completing safety sweep logs, and ensuring displays and fixtures are secure and free of debris.

Flexibility (Availability/Work Schedule)

  • Be open to working a variety of shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on business needs. Your adaptability helps ensure the store runs smoothly and customers receive consistent, high-quality service.

POTENTIAL CHALLENGES IN THIS ROLE

High Task Volume in a Fast-Paced Environment

  • Manages overnight hours effectively and planning accordingly to stay energized and focused.
  • Effectively manages work hours and plans ahead to maintain energy and focus throughout the shift.
  • Handles a fast-paced workload with efficiency, ensuring large volumes of restocking and recovery are completed accurately and on time.

Physical Demands

  • Performs physical tasks such as standing for extended periods, bending, and lifting inventory, equipment, or supplies weighing up to 20 lbs., and occasionally up to 50 lbs.
  • Performs repetitive tasks such as stocking, zoning, and organizing products with attention to detail and consistency to uphold store standards.

WHY YOU'LL ENJOY WORKING HERE

Energetic, Fast-Paced Environment

Thrive in a dynamic setting where every day brings something new.

Appreciation for Your Efforts

Your contributions are recognized and valued.

Career Growth Opportunities

Build your skills and advance your career with us.

Meaningful Impact

Take pride in helping customers save money and live better.

The minimum rate of pay for this position starts from $19.35.

jobs.title: Executive Social Media Specialist (Contract)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Office of the CEO works directly with Amjad Masad and CEO leadership to advance Replit's strategy, external presence, and long-term positioning. This role sits at the intersection of the Office of the CEO and Replit's Brand and Creative function, with a singular focus: building personal presence into one of the defining founder voices of the AI era.

The Executive Social Media Specialist will build an intentional, premium, long-term strategy across visual channels, primarily Instagram. This is an all-in-one creative operator role, not a traditional social media manager. You will travel and capture meaningful moments as they happen, edit quickly, and publish polished content without relying on a larger production team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own photography, videography, editing, and publishing across official social channels

 - Travel with the CEO to capture speaking engagements, interviews, awards, office visits, and meaningful meetings as they happen

 - Identify and produce content around the pillars that have proven to resonate: founder story and personal journey, entrepreneurship and company building, global perspective and cultural identity, and human founder moments

 - Develop premium, documentary-style storytelling that favors real moments over manufactured content

 - Build out a presence on Instagram and other visual mediums through premium photography, documentary-style video, and behind-the-scenes storytelling

 - Maintain quality and brand guardrails, prioritizing credibility and long-term influence over trend-chasing, gimmicks, or a high-volume creator posting cadence

 - Partner closely with Replit's Marketing and Communications teams while remaining focused on distinct personal brand

 - Move from concept to final execution independently, with strong creative judgment and a fast turnaround




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Proven experience producing premium photography and video content for an executive, founder, public figure, or creator, ideally including hands-on shooting and editing

 - A portfolio demonstrating documentary-style storytelling, not just short-form trend content

 - Comfort and flexibility with travel, as the role involves capturing real-world moments and appearances

 - Strong judgment on tone and positioning, able to distinguish content that builds long-term credibility from content that chases short-term engagement

 - Ability to work independently across the full production cycle: capture, edit, and publish

 - Familiarity with platform-specific storytelling across Instagram and other visual, photo- and video-first mediums

 - Discretion and professionalism given close proximity to executive and personal moments

 - Experience building a personal or executive brand from an early stage is a strong plus




CONTRACT ENGAGEMENT INCLUDES

 - Competitive contract rate, with compensation

 - Direct, high-visibility partnership with Replit's CEO and Office of the CEO

 - Autonomous work environment with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy



This is a contract role and does not offer full time benefits.

jobs.description:
Associate Professor or Assistant Professor (promotion track) in Psychiatry

(Valid from 11/08/2026 to 26/01/2027)

Functions: Associate / Assistant Professor
Role Type: Open Position

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character. Interdisciplinarity in research and teaching is key to the University's approach to addressing tomorrow's societal challenges. Embedded in Luxembourg's diverse and multicultural society, the University offers a welcoming, multilingual environment where students and researchers from around the world feel at home. Its human size fosters close interaction between students and lecturers, creating a personal atmosphere. With 1,600 members of academic staff for 6,700+ students and 1,000+ Ph.D. candidates, students feel connected and valued on their academic journey. Internationally recognised research drives innovation in digital transformation, health, and sustainable development. This scientific progress is supported by cutting-edge infrastructure and a national commitment to education, research, and innovation. The dynamics of a young university offer rare potential and scope for exploring new ideas.

The Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) is part of the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. DHML coordinates all teaching programmes in medicine, life sciences, nursing, radiography and midwifery. Research at the department integrates basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches with a focus on cancer biology, as well as clinical research projects on human health and disease. Related research within the University encompasses clinical psychology and cognitive sciences at the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) and research on neurological disorders and dementia at the Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB).

The DHML cooperates with national health care centres and with leading international biomedical research institutions. The University of Luxembourg has set a strategic focus on medicine and health and is actively developing its training and research areas in these domains, creating exceptional opportunities in medical, biomedical and mental health initiatives.

Your role

As part of the University's expansion of its medical and health sciences portfolio, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences seeks to appoint a Professor in Psychiatry. The successful candidate will establish and lead the medical specialisation programme (Diplômes d'Études Spécialisées – DES) in psychiatry, contribute to ongoing initiatives for mental health support and develop a strong line of research in a related field.

The position combines innovative postgraduate teaching in psychiatry with the development of an interdisciplinary research programme, supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure and excellent possibilities for collaborative work, particularly in neurosciences, clinical psychology and cognitive sciences.

The professorship represents a rare opportunity to shape the further development of medical education and research at the University of Luxembourg in close cooperation with colleagues across the University as well as with local and international hospitals.

The successful candidate will:

• Design, develop and implement a modern, state-of-the-art psychiatry curriculum
• Lead the medical specialisation programme in psychiatry and coordinate psychiatry-related teaching activities within the University's study programmes in medicine and other health-related sciences
• Collaborate with faculty colleagues and clinical partners to ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students
• Implement innovative educational approaches and digital learning resources to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities
• Establish research activities in psychiatry or related disciplines
• Integrate into ongoing research endeavours in mental health, e.g. Department of Behavioural and Cognitive Sciences, and/or neurosciences, e.g. Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine
• Supervise Master students and PhD candidates
• Contribute to translational efforts in advancing mental health care, e.g. early detection, prevention, innovative treatments, integration of digital solutions
• Engage in clinical psychiatry in Luxembourg

For further information about the role, please contact: Professor Serge Haan, Head of the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences,

Email: Serge.Haan@uni.lu

Your profile

• MD degree and PhD or equivalent doctoral qualification
• Relevant clinical qualification in psychiatry and significant clinical experience; at least 5 years of practice
• Robust experience in teaching psychiatry at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level
• Authorization or eligibility to apply for authorization to practice as a psychiatrist in Luxembourg
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching
• Experience in designing and implementing new educational programmes or courses at university level
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, including online learning platforms and simulation-based training
• Strong track record in clinical and/or biomedical research in a relevant domain, with international recognition, a focus on therapeutic processes and/or aetiological research on mental disorders will be considered an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and sustain academic and clinical partnerships, particularly with partner universities and healthcare institutions
• Visionary and transformational leadership skills, ability to thrive in a dynamic and pioneering academic environment

Language requirements:

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• A strategic opportunity to shape and lead the development of psychiatry education and research within an interdisciplinary environment and a growing medical faculty
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply

Applications should contain:

• Cover letter, to be addressed to Dr. Serge Haan, Head of Department
• Curriculum Vitae; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Short description of profile, key achieve [...]

jobs.title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.  

Attributes and Qualities

• Leadership & People Management                                
• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

• MS Office proficiency

Languages Skills

• English: Fluent
• Any other Quintet language is considered an asset

Job Description



ArcelorMittal Long Products Luxembourg recherche pour son équipe SUPPLY CHAIN : un(e) Gestionnaire flotte ferroviaire

Objectif du poste

Assurer le pilotage et l'optimisation de la flotte de wagons LPL afin de garantir la disponibilité des moyens nécessaires aux activités logistiques, d'optimiser la rotation des actifs ferroviaires et de contribuer à la performance globale de la chaîne logistique.

Le poste couvre l'ensemble des flux ferroviaires liés aux wagons chargés, wagons vides, wagons de demi-produits et wagons de mitrailles.



Responsabilités

Gestion et optimisation de la flotte

• Réaliser la revue annuelle du dimensionnement de la flotte en fonction des besoins budgétés.
• Analyser les performances de la flotte et proposer les ajustements nécessaires afin d'optimiser son utilisation et les coûts associés.
• Assurer le suivi quotidien de la position, de la disponibilité, de l'état et de la rotation des wagons.



Coordination opérationnelle

• Garantir la disponibilité des wagons nécessaires au programme de transport.
• Identifier et traiter les anomalies impactant les flux ferroviaires (retards, rétention client, avaries, restrictions d'infrastructure, déséquilibres de flotte, etc.).
• Coordonner les opérations de repositionnement, parkage, déparkage et remise en exploitation des wagons.
• Orienter les actions nécessaires avec les transporteurs ferroviaires, les sites de production, les Order Managers et les équipes de planification.



Reporting et amélioration continue

Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance, produire les reportings nécessaires et proposer les actions d'amélioration adaptées.

Principaux KPI :

    Nombre de wagons vides disponibles au Luxembourg.
    Nombre de wagons en maintenance, révision ou réparation.
    Rotation des wagons par axe et par type de flux.
    Nombre de trains annulés ou impactés pour manque de charge ou de wagons.
    Taux de remplissage des trains.
    Temps moyen d'immobilisation des wagons.

Polyvalence

Assurer le remplacement du coordinateur approvisionnement mitraille et participer à toute activité contribuant au bon fonctionnement des opérations ferroviaires et logistiques quand nécessaire. (SOP équilibrage des flux)



Compétences requises

• Maîtrise de SAP et Excel.
• Bonne compréhension des flux industriels, logistiques et ferroviaires.
• Capacité d'analyse, d'organisation et de résolution de problèmes.
• Rigueur, autonomie et réactivité.
• Bonnes capacités de communication et de coordination.
• Anglais professionnel.

jobs.title: SLASTIČAR/SLASTIČARKA
jobs.description:
Tražimo Slastičara / Slastičarku koji/a se želi priključiti jednom od vodećih i omiljenih brendova u Dalmaciji – La Delti!

S tradicijom koja traje već skoro 40 godina, La Delta ponosno spaja kvalitetne domaće sastojke, stručnost tima, modernu proizvodnju i povjerenje kupaca! Naši su proizvodi poput torti i kolača važan dio obiteljskih proslava, blagdana i svakodnevnih slatkih trenutaka tisuće naših kupaca.

Kako bismo nastavili širiti ponudu vrhunskih i prepoznatljivih slastica, tražimo kreativnu, motiviranu i pedantnu osobu koja želi razvijati svoje vještine u radu sa slasticama i profesionalno rasti unutar etabliranog brenda!

Pridružite nam se i postanite dio jedne od najprepoznatljivijih slastičarskih priča Splita i okolice!

Dobro došli u La Delta tim!

ZADACI I ODGOVORNOSTI

Ovisno o Vašem dosadašnjem iskustvu, znanju i afinitetima, Vaš rad obuhvaćat će:

ŠTO TRAŽIMO?

  • KV/SSS/VŠS (prehrambeni, slastičarski ili tehnološki smjer je prednost, ali nije uvjet)

  • Proaktivnost i smirenost u dinamičnom radnom okruženju
  • Sposobnost timskog rada i dobre komunikacije
  • Želju za učenjem i usavršavanjem novih znanja

Nemate veliko iskustvo, ali imate pravu motivaciju i želju naučiti posao? Javite nam se! Uz podršku iskusnog mentora pomoći ćemo vam da se kvalitetno uvedete u posao i razvijete svoje vještine.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? jobs.title: Cloud Developer (w/m/d) / Remote Spain (Cloud-Architect)
jobs.description:
Willkommen in der Welt der medizinischen Innovationen!

Bei Mesalvo geht es nicht nur um Technologie – es geht um Menschen, um Fortschritt und um die Verbesserung der Gesundheitsversorgung für alle. Wir sind ein Unternehmen, das von der Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und modernste Technologien angetrieben wird. Unsere Grundlage ist eine tiefe medizinische Expertise, auf der wir innovative und vernetzte Softwarelösungen aufbauen. Unsere Vision ist klar: ein maßgeschneidertes, digitales Gesundheitsmanagement, das den Klinikalltag erleichtert.

Unsere Geschichte begann 2021, als wir fünf renommierte Unternehmen der Health Care IT-Branche unter einem Dach vereinten. Diese Fusion brachte nicht nur verschiedene Expertisen und Werte, sondern auch 460+ hochmotivierte Mitarbeitende an insgesamt 7 Standorten in Deutschland, Belgien und Spanien zusammen.

Klingt das nach einem Umfeld, in dem du dich entfalten möchtest? Dann werde Teil der Mesalvo-Familie und trage dazu bei, dass die Gesundheitsversorgung smarter, effizienter und menschenorientierter wird. Deine Ideen, deine Leidenschaft und dein Engagement sind hier gefragt – denn gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied! Empower Excellence in Health and Care: #empowerexcellence

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich

- Du wirst Teil unseres Softwareentwicklungsteams und arbeitest an unserer innovativen Logistiklösung für Krankenhausapotheken namens Ataxe Web
- Du gestaltest, entwickelst und optimierst moderne cloudnative Anwendungen auf Basis von Java 21 und Spring Boot
- Du konzipierst und implementierst zukunftsfähige Microservice-Architekturen
- Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme höchsten Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Datenschutz und Kosteneffizienz gerecht werden
- Du entwickelst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in bestehende Anwendungen
- Du arbeitest mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL und MongoDB, inklusive Performance-Optimierung und Sicherstellung der Datenkonsistenz
- Du setzt auf moderne Entwicklungspraktiken wie Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean Code
- Du arbeitest eng mit Frontend-Entwickler:innen sowie interdisziplinären Teams zusammen

Das bringst Du mit

- Du verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Java 21
- Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse im Spring Framework, Spring Boot und Hibernate mit
- Du hast Erfahrung mit Test-Driven Development (TDD), Refactoring und Clean-Code-Prinzipien
- Du konntest bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Cloud-Services sammeln
- Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken, insbesondere in den Bereichen Redundanzvermeidung, Performance-Optimierung und Datenkonsistenz
- Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung verteilter Systeme mit Fokus auf moderne Cloud-Anforderungen
- Du gehst sicher mit Docker um
- Du kommunizierst sicher auf Englisch in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Unser Angebot als Arbeitgeber

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten: In Absprache mit deinem Team kannst du entscheiden, wann dein Tag startet.
- Remote Work: Mobiles Arbeiten, Home-Office oder bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland - du entscheidest wo du dich am wohlsten fühlst.
- Mitarbeitenden Benefits: Vom Jobrad bis zum Fitnessstudio – deine Bewegung kommt bei uns nicht zu kurz.
- Gesundheitsförderung: Freu dich auf verschiedene Angebote, die deiner Gesundheit guttun – denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.
- Events: Damit der Spaß nicht zu kurz kommt, organisieren wir regelmäßig Firmenläufe, Teamevents und Weihnachtsfeiern.
- Onboarding: Sorgfältige Einarbeitung durch ein nettes und offenes Team – dieses steht dir während deines Onboarding-Prozesses jederzeit zur Verfügung.

Unser Herz schlägt für IT und wir leben Diversity

Wir haben die Charta der Vielfalt unterzeichnet und setzen uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion am Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir freuen uns über eine Vielfalt an unterschiedlichen Bewerbenden, die mit uns noch erfolgreicher werden möchten und Ihre Leidenschaft mit uns teilen.

Homeoffice:
Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Refactoring, Programmiersprache Java, Test-driven Development (TDD)
Expertenkenntnisse: Spring Framework, Hibernate Framework, Cloud Computing

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. •    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).

General & HSE:
