jobs.description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:

Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Was du ownst

Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.

1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet

Purpose of the role  

  *  In this role, you contribute to the development of advanced technical solutions that improve assembly processes and ensure reliable end-of-line testing.
  *  Strong collaboration, structured problem-solving, and a high standard of technical quality are essential to support efficient and stable manufacturing operations.
  *  As an Automation Engineer in Industrial Engineering, you play a key role in designing, developing, maintaining, and standardizing technical solutions for assembly lines and end-of-line testing equipment.
  *  Your work directly supports the efficiency, quality, and reliability of manufacturing processes across global sites.


Responsibilities:

  *  Development of Assembly and End-of-Line Testing Equipment


  *  Execute the full development lifecycle for automated and system-controlled assembly and end-of-line testing equipment, with a focus on automation, as part of project teams.
  *  Design, build, validate, and release automation equipment and devices for production use in collaboration with VAT Group teams and external suppliers.
  *  Work with global cross-functional teams to collect user requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  *  Support global sites in the introduction of new end-of-line test processes, including the development and release of production and test equipment for new product introductions and new process requirements.
  *  Develop and implement technical solutions that meet industry standards and follow engineering best practices.


  *  Project Management and Documentation


  *  Prepare clear and accurate technical specification documents in line with applicable CE conformity requirements.

  *  Integrate electrical and electronic components into fully functional automation systems.
  *  Develop verification plans and support quality assurance activities.


  *  Troubleshooting and Continuous Improvement


  *  Analyze, optimize, and upgrade existing automation solutions.
  *  Maintain technical documentation and ensure functional definitions remain up to date.
  *  Review user feedback and implement necessary improvements and updates.
  *  Provide third-level technical support to local sites when required.


Qualifications:  

  *  Experience with manufacturing equipment connectivity, including communication protocols and system architecture.
  *  Experience in the automation of production processes and end-of-line testing.
  *  Experience in the automation of assembly and end-of-line testing processes.
  *  Experience contributing to cross-functional projects in an industrial environment.
  *  A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage.

  *  Knowledge of engineering development processes and working methods.
  *  Good communication skills in English; German is an advantage.

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

 - Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

 - Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

 - Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

 - Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to grow Replit’s core creation products, including Design and Slides.

These products already give people new ways to turn an idea into something they can see, share, and use. Your job is to help more people discover them, understand when to use them, and make them part of their regular workflow.

You’ll own the connection between the product and its audiences: developing positioning grounded in customer needs, leading launches, finding channels that can drive sustained adoption, tracking the competitive landscape, and bringing market feedback back to Product.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Growth, Brand, and Creative. It is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, write the narrative, and get the work into the market.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the positioning and growth strategy for Replit’s core products, including Design and Slides. Develop audience-focused narratives, identify new use cases and channels, bring product improvements to market, and build programs that drive adoption, engagement, and conversion. Track competitors and customer needs, then translate those insights into sharper messaging, stronger go-to-market decisions, and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Self-starter: You take ownership, work through ambiguity, and move from strategy to execution without waiting for a perfect brief.

 - Audience-focused: You turn customer insight into clear positioning, relevant narratives, and campaigns built for specific audiences.

 - Growth-minded: You find creative ways to expand adoption, test new channels and tactics, and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.

 - Deep product background: You understand complex products, work closely with Product and Engineering, and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer value.

 - Strong product marketer: You bring 4+ years of experience growing product-led, consumer, prosumer, creative, or developer-focused products.

SEO Specialist

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. jobs.title: Media Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions

Etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, jolla on riittävästi käytännön kokemusta siihen, että tavalliset huolto- ja korjaustyöt sekä haastavampi vianetsintä onnistuvat itsenäisesti.

Kyseessä ei ole työnjohto- tai kouluttajan tehtävä, vaan haemme ennen kaikkea **itse korjaamotöitä tekevää kokenutta asentajaa**.

**Työtehtäviä**

Työhön kuuluu: henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- mekaaninen vianetsintä

- sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- diagnostiikkalaitteiden käyttö

- jarru-, alusta-, moottori- ja voimansiirtotyöt

- kykyä saattaa työ loppuun asti

Myös pitkän työuran tehneet asentajat ovat erittäin tervetulleita hakemaan.

Vakituinen työsuhde ei ole ainoa mahdollinen yhteistyömalli.

- omalla toiminimellä

- osakeyhtiön kautta

- kevytyrittäjänä

- itsenäisenä autoalan ammattilaisena


voimme keskustella myös toimeksiantopohjaisesta yhteistyöstä.

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Airports Holding Limited: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

Job Purpose: Firefighter is responsible for responding to aircraft and structural fire emergencies, medical emergencies, hazardous material incidents, and other emergencies within the airport premises. This role involves ensuring the safety and security of passengers, crew, and airport personnel by performing firefighting, rescue and emergency medical services.

Responsibilities

Emergency Response:

Respond promptly to aircraft incidents, structural fires, medical emergencies, hazardous materials incidents, and other emergency situations on airport property.

Perform firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical services to ensure the safety of individuals and property.

Fire Suppression

Extinguish fires using various firefighting techniques, including the use of water, foam, dry chemicals, and other firefighting agents.

Conduct search and rescue operations in smoke-filled and hazardous environments.

Emergency Medical Services

Provide first aid and basic life support (BLS) to injured or ill individuals until advanced medical personnel arrive.

Assist in the transportation of patients to medical facilities as needed.

Operational Readiness

Perform daily inspections and maintenance of firefighting vehicles, extinguishers, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

Maintain inventory of firefighting supplies and equipment and ensure their readiness for use.

Participate in routine emergency response simulations, ICAO-mandated training, and fire drills.

Maintain detailed incident reports, training records, and shift logs for regulatory audits.

Compliance And Reporting

Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations and guidelines related to firefighting and emergency response and ensure all tasks are performed following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Identify potential hazards during patrols and inspections, ensuring immediate corrective action.

Prepare and submit accurate incident reports, equipment logs, and other required documentation.

Collaboration And Coordination

Collaborate with airport operations, medical services, and external emergency agencies during incidents.

Coordinate with the Duty Manager, ATC, and airport authorities during emergency operations and drills.

Duty Manager - ARFF

Airport Operations Team

Airport Security

Emergency Medical Services

ARFF Crew Members

Engineering & Maintenance Team

Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Team

Key Stakeholders - External

Local Fire Services Department

Airlines Operating at the Airport

Ground Handling Companies

ARFF Equipment Manufacturers/Service Providers

Insurance Companies

Local Community Leaders

Civil Aviation Authorities

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Diploma in Fire Fighting Technology or equivalent qualification.

Certification from an accredited firefighting academy is required.

Work Experience

2-3 years of experience firefighting experience, preferably in aircraft rescue and fire fighting (ARFF) operations.

SHORT ANSWERAsk questions that show you've already started solving their problems, not just learning about the company. Focus on how your unique skills will contribute to their specific goals, using details from the job posting and your resume to frame your inquiries. Your questions should reveal your strategic value, not just your curiosity.

That moment at the end of an interview, when they turn the tables and ask, "Do you have any questions for us?" can feel like a pop quiz. Most anxious job seekers just want to get through it, but this is actually your final, best chance to show them you're the solution to their problems. I promise, you can turn this moment into a powerful demonstration of your value.

ONE LINE EACH Who I am The proof What I want next say it in one breath

FIG. 02I used to ramble when someone asked what I did. Now I keep three lines ready: who I am, the proof, and what I want next. When all three stack into one breath, people remember you.

  • 01 How do I show I've already started thinking about their problems?

Frame your questions around specific challenges or goals mentioned in the job posting or throughout the interview, demonstrating youâre already in problem-solving mode for them. This shifts you from interviewee to potential partner, showing youâre not just looking for a job, but for impact. Youâre not asking what they do; youâre asking how you can help them do it better.

For example, if the posting mentions expanding into a new market, you might ask, "I noticed the posting highlighted a push into the APAC region. What specific metrics are you tracking for success in that expansion over the next 12 months, and how do you see this role directly contributing to those early wins?" This tells them you read the posting, you understand their strategic direction, and you're already thinking about measurable outcomes. It's a much stronger signal than, "What's the team culture like?" I want you to make every question a mini pitch for your specific skills.

  • 02

Should I ask about the 30/60/90 day plan?

Asking about the 30/60/90 day plan is a smart move, but only if you frame it to show how you'd execute your own plan, not just hear theirs. This question can reveal critical expectations and allow you to align your prepared 30/60/90 day plan from your Baldwin Blueprint with their vision. It's about demonstrating initiative and foresight.

Instead of "What would my 30/60/90 day plan look like?" try, "Based on our conversation about [specific challenge or project], what would be the top one or two priorities you'd want someone in this role to tackle and deliver measurable results on within their first 90 days?" This invites them to share their critical needs, and you can then connect those needs to your own Experience Accelerator and 30/60/90 day plan, which your Blueprint helps you build from the actual job posting. It shows you're not just waiting for instructions; you're ready to hit the ground running with concrete contributions.

Four rooms, four scorecards Manager Peer Partner Skip level JUDGMENT CRAFT TEAMWORK GROWTH answer the real scorer

FIG. 03An interview loop is not one test, it is four. Each person in the room is measuring a different thing: the hiring manager scores judgment, the peer scores craft, the cross functional partner scores collaboration, and the skip level scores trajectory. Speak to what each one is actually grading. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What's a question that shows I'm thinking long-term?

A question that shows you're thinking long-term connects your potential contributions to the company's broader strategic goals, positioning you as an investment, not just a hire. This demonstrates ambition and a desire to grow with the company, making your candidacy more compelling. Itâs about signaling that you see a future with them.

Consider asking, "Beyond the immediate responsibilities, what are the biggest strategic shifts or initiatives this team expects to navigate in the next 18 to 24 months, and how does this role evolve to support those changes?" This shows you're looking beyond the immediate tasks and are interested in the trajectory of the company and your potential role within it. It's a question that conveys seriousness about your career and their future, which hiring managers appreciate. It pushes past the tactical and into the strategic, which is where true impact lies.

THEY ASK Any questions for us? YOU ASK Where do projects stall before they ship? this is the interview too

FIG. 04The questions you ask are part of the interview, not a polite afterthought. When they ask if you have questions, skip the perks and ask about the real work: what success looks like in 90 days, where projects stall, who owns the roadmap. The questions you ask reveal how you think, so make them sharp.

  • 04 Is there anything I should absolutely NOT ask?

Avoid asking questions that are easily answered by a quick search of the company website or questions solely focused on benefits, salary, or vacation time at this stage. These types of questions signal a lack of preparation or a self-serving focus, detracting from your professional image. Your final questions should reinforce your value, not raise doubts.

I also tell people to avoid asking questions that are overly generic or could apply to any company, like "What do you like most about working here?" While it's okay to build rapport, your final questions are for demonstrating strategic fit. Save the generic questions for networking calls, not the interview's closing act. Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to ask what you want to know, not what *they* need to hear. Your Baldwin Blueprint helps you identify their core needs directly from the job posting, so your questions can be laser focused on those.

  • 05

How do I ask a question that makes me stand out?

Ask a question that directly references a detail from your resume or the job posting, then connect it to a strategic signal or an Account Map insight from your Baldwin Blueprint. This type of question makes you memorable because it's specific, personalized, and demonstrates deep preparation. It shows you've done your homework and understand their world.

For example, if your resume highlights a specific project management success, and the job posting emphasizes improving project timelines, you could ask: "Given my experience leading the [Project Name] initiative, where we reduced delivery times by 15%, what are the current bottlenecks in your project pipeline that you envision this role specifically addressing?" This isn't just a question; it's a subtle reminder of your relevant achievements and a direct offer to solve their problems. Itâs about making a direct link between your past success and their future needs. This is the difference between a good candidate and the one they can't stop thinking about.

Worked example

  • 30/60/90 line

Before

What are the biggest challenges this role will face?

After

Based on my research into your Q3 earnings call, where you discussed streamlining supply chain logistics, what specific data sources or key stakeholders would be critical for me to engage with in my first 30 days to begin mapping out an optimization strategy for that area?

Interview Questions: Impact vs. Inquiry What most people do What actually works Ask about team culture or company benefits. Ask how your specific skills solve their problems. Ask for a job description summary. Refer to a specific point from the job posting or their website. Ask generic questions from a list. Craft questions that lead to an offer, not just information. Ask questions that show you're curious. Ask questions that show you're already contributing. Wait to be told what to do. Propose how you'll make an immediate impact.

The takeaways

  • 01Ask questions that solve problems, not just gather info.
  • 02Reference the job posting and your resume directly.
  • 03Frame questions to reveal your strategic value.
  • 04Use your 30/60/90 plan to guide your questions.

Questions people ask

What if I don't have any questions left after our conversation?

It's rare that you won't have any questions if you're truly engaged, but if it happens, you can say, "You've been incredibly thorough, and I feel I have a strong understanding of the role and team. I'm confident I can contribute significantly." Then, pivot to reiterating your interest and fit. You can also offer to follow up if new questions arise.

Is this just a fancy cover letter? What does Baldwin Blueprint actually do?

No, it's much more. A cover letter is static. Baldwin Blueprint turns the actual job posting and your resume into a living 12 page strategic Blueprint you walk in with. It includes an Impact Memo, an Account Map, Strategic Signals, an Experience Accelerator, and a 30/60/90 day plan tailored specifically to that role. It's built from the actual posting, and the first draft is free, no card required. It gives you concrete, specific content for every stage of the interview, including the questions you ask.

How many questions should I ask?

Aim for 2 to 3 strong, impactful questions. Quality over quantity. You want to leave them thinking about your insights, not just how many questions you had. If your questions are strategic and well-researched, you won't need many to make a lasting impression. Focus on the ones that highlight your unique value and understanding of the role.

What if the interviewer seems rushed?

If they seem rushed, acknowledge it respectfully. "I know we're short on time, so I'll just ask one key question: based on our conversation, what's the single most critical challenge this role needs to solve in the first 6 months?" This shows you're observant and considerate, while still landing a powerful, focused question. It's about adapting to the situation while still making your point.

jobs.description:
The Hiring Field Manual

What does 'fast-paced environment' actually mean for my day to day?

By Chris Baldwin

  • Founder, Baldwin Blueprint
  • Updated June 2026

Study this sheet

SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

  • STAR answer

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

Sources

Ramirent vuokraa rakennuskoneita asiakkaiden työmaille ympäri Suomen. Huollamme koneet määräaikana sekä korjaamme puutteet sekä viat ammattitaitoisesti. Pidämme huolen siitä, että vuokrakalustomme on asiakkaitamme varten aina siistinä ja hyvässä toimintakunnossa.

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

jobs.title: Directeur d'Hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez diriger un établissement à taille humaine tout en étant au cœur de l'action ?

Rejoignez l'univers chaleureux et convivial des Hôtels Inn Design, où satisfaction client et gestion opérationnelle sont les piliers du quotidien!

Description du poste

En tant que Responsable d'établissement, vous êtes le garant de la performance globale de l'hôtel et de la satisfaction client. Vous jouez un rôle central dans le pilotage quotidien en lien étroit avec les équipes et les clients.

Vos missions principales :

Accueil & expérience client :
- Accueil physique et téléphonique d'une clientèle nationale et internationale
- Mise en place du petit-déjeuner et service en restauration
- Suivi des retours clients et gestion des demandes spécifiques

Commercialisation:
- Valoriser votre sens du commerce pour identifier et saisir les opportunités de croissance sur votre marché

Encadrement des équipes :
- Animer, motiver et organiser le travail des collaborateurs, gérer les plannings et accompagner le développement des compétences.

Gestion opérationnelle :
- Gestion des réservations, des arrivées/départs (check-in/check-out), facturation, encaissements, contrôle des caisses.
- Suivi du standard téléphonique, des e-mails et de la communication avec les clients.
- Organisation des espaces séminaires : installation, matériel, rangement.
- Suivi et gestion des stocks : petit-déjeuner, bar, fournitures.

Hygiène et conformité :
- S'assurer du respect rigoureux des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité, du contrôle qualité des chambres à la propreté des espaces communs et des cuisines.

Conditions spécifiques :
- Poste logé
- Astreintes hebdomadaires, avec autonomie dans la gestion opérationnelle.
- Postes à pourvoir partout en France

Votre profil :
- Vous avez une première expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement hôtelier, avec management d'équipe.
- Vous aimez la polyvalence et la gestion opérationnelle
- Orienté(e) résultats, vous savez mobiliser votre équipe autour d'objectifs communs tout en valorisant la cohésion et la performance.

jobs.title: Experienced Location Designer
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are now looking for an experienced Location Designer to work on a new series Backyard Sports. Join us in our quest to create the best possible animated content for our partners. We are looking for someone who can start as of the 17th of August 2026 and the role will run until the 16th of October 2026. 'Backyard Sports' is a new series based on the widely popular video 90's game franchise of the same name. Playground Pictures are modernising the 'Backyard Sports' universe and the beloved characters in a new and exciting animated series. The series is an homage to the game and explores how - no matter your background or chaos that may happen in life - everyone has a place in the Backyard Sports community. For this role, candidates may work either from our Kilkenny studio or remotely within the Republic of Ireland, there is no option to work freelance from outside of Ireland About the role As a location designer, you are responsible for exploring and creating environments that set the stage for a production, while ensuring the designs are functional for production. What you'll be doing Finalise and clean up designs using Photoshop Execute changes on designs based on feedback from the art lead and/or assistant director/director Maintain the overall location style Demonstrate strong visual interpretation skills Keep team informed of potential creative problems Ensure that production deadlines are met while maintaining the highest standard of quality Draft, design and layout locations from script/animatic/briefs The above is not exhaustive and from time to time you may be asked to carry out other tasks. What we're looking for 3+ years of Professional Studio experience as a Location Designer Strong understanding of traditional 2D principles Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize work Attention to detail and ability to find solutions Experience with Shotgrid/Flow is considered a plus

jobs.title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VAASA

Haemme APULAISRAVINTOLAPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Vaasassa toimiviin ravintola- ja kokoustoimintoihin.

Haemme nyt rohkeaa ja tuloshakuista päällikköä vetämään ja johtamaan huipputiimiä. Jos tunnet suurta paloa ravintola-alaa ja ihmisiä kohtaan, tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn, jossa pääset näyttämään taitosi ja edelleen kehittymään.

Tässä roolissa saat mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa sekä työntekijöiden että vieraiden arkeen. Työn ytimessä ovat onnistuneen työntekijäkokemuksen johtaminen, loistavan vieraskokemuksen varmistaminen sekä tuloksellisuus. Tehdään yhdessä vieraidemme arjesta juhlaa!

Pidät huolta, että tiimisi kukoistaa ja työntekijäsi voivat hyvin. Olet tärkeässä osassa kannustavan työkulttuurin kehittämisessä. Meillä jokainen tuntee olevansa osa tiimiä sekä pääsee halutessaan kehittymään. Tiedämme, että innostuneet työntekijät saavat aikaan ilahtuneita vieraita, ja tämä filosofia näkyy kaikessa tekemisessämme.

Tiedät, että menestyminen edellyttää myös liiketoiminnan tunnuslukujen ymmärtämistä ja osaamista: Ymmärrät alan perusrealiteetit, tunnistat mahdollisuudet ja haasteet sekä kykenet tekemään tarvittavia muutoksia liiketoiminnan kannattavuuden varmistamiseksi. Olet rohkea päätösten tekijä ja johdat tiimiäsi esimerkillä kohti tavoitteita.

Tyypillinen työviikko tai -päivä on täynnä monipuolisia haasteita, jotka otat vastaan innostuneesti. Työaikasi painottuu arki-iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin – silloinhan vieraammekin ovat meillä! Jokainen kohtaaminen vieraan kanssa on mahdollisuus luoda positiivista kaikua, joten pyrit jatkuvasti parantamaan palvelun laatua ja vastaamaan vieraan tarpeisiin.

Odotamme sinulta selkeää viestintää ja kykyä kannustaa tiimiäsi parhaisiin suorituksiin. Kielitaitosi on meille arvokas resurssi. Olemme superinnoissamme, jos sinulta loytyy kunnianhimoa, muutoshalua ja luontaista taipumusta ajatella laatikon ulkopuolelta. Meillä paaset viemaan eteenpain omia kehitysideoitasi ja olemaan mukana ravintola-alannopeissa muutoksissa.

Laitathan hakemuksen ja cv:n sisään viimeistään 6.9.2026. Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana. Lisäinfoa tarvittaessa: Sami Lehtonen, ravintolapäällikkö Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Vaasa, sami.2.lehtonen@sok.fi, 020 780 8809.

120- vuotias Osuuskauppa KPO on lähes 1,2 miljardin euron vuosimyynnillään Suomen suurimpia alueosuuskauppoja. Toimimme Kokkolan, Pietarsaaren, Vaasan ja Ylivieskan talousalueilla. Olemme alueemme marketkaupan markkina- ja hintajohtaja sekä markkinajohtajia polttoneste-, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa. Lisäksi harjoitamme autokauppaa. Meillä on 140 000 asiakasomistajaa ja työllistämme noin 2 300 palvelualan ammattilaista. Osuuskauppa KPO on useampana vuonna saanut Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat -tunnustuksen. Toimintamme taloudellinen menestys päätyy kokonaisuudessaan kauppapalvelujemme kestävään kehittämiseen ja asiakasomistajiemme eduksi.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Suomusjärvi ja Sale Kiikala
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SALO

Etsimme nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen tehtävään Suomusjärven & Kiikalan Saleen! Tehtävä on osa-aikainen, 20 h/vko.Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tekemisen meiningistä. Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä!

Salen myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita tylsää tai merkityksetöntä – päinvastoin! Meille tavallista on asiakkaiden hurmaaminen leveällä hymyllä ja reippaalla työotteella.

Toivomme, että pidät asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta, tiimityöskentelystä, fyysisestä työstä ja reippaasta työtahdista. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa n. klo 7–21 välillä. Tehtävä edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä sekä Kiikalan että Suomusjärven Salessa. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on tarpeen toimipisteiden sijainnin vuoksi.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
Ihan tavallisia töitä, ja erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 10,89–14,57 € /h. Ja lisät päälle!

Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.

Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.

Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.

Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana.


💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: syyskuussa 2026 sopimuksen mukaan
Huomaathan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja valintapäätökset tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 myymäläpäällikköElina Valdemarsson joko puhelimitse p. 044320 5780 tai sähköpostitse elina.valdemarsson@sok.fi

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You Essential Experience & Skills Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**The Role**

**We're looking for a Data Scientist to do the quantitative analysis behind a large-scale data quality program. When our data engineering team's monitors flag a statistical anomaly in large, human-generated rating and annotation data, you'll be the one who determines whether it's genuine signal or ordinary noise, and if it's real, what's actually driving it. You'll triage confirmed findings into the right remediation lane, turn your analysis into fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups, and help build the dashboards and reporting views that make your findings visible to the team and stakeholders. You'll operate on a two-week sprint cadence as part of a small, distributed team, reporting into the program's Data Scientist Lead.**

**What You'll Do**

- **Take anomalies flagged by the data engineering team's monitoring systems and apply statistical methods (hypothesis testing, distributional comparisons, cohort/segment analysis) to classify each as genuine signal or ordinary noise/drift.**

- **Run root-cause analysis on confirmed anomalies in rating/annotation data — for example, comparing cohorts to identify what distinguishes an outlier group from the rest of the population — to identify the likely driver.**

- **Triage confirmed findings into the correct remediation lane: contributor-side issues (route to our internal Quality team for remediation) versus process-side issues (route back to the client's program team as a guideline or workflow fix).**

- **Turn analysis into clear, concise, fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups that feed the team's stakeholder cadence, owned by the Data Scientist Lead.**

- **Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting views (in partnership with data engineering) that surface anomaly trends, cohort findings, and turnaround metrics to the team and stakeholders.**

- **Work within tight, SLA-driven turnaround windows, delivering diagnosis-ready findings within hours — not days — once an issue is flagged.**

- **Participate fully in a two-week sprint cadence: sprint planning, review, and continuous improvement of analysis methodology.**

- **Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, the Data Scientist Lead, and program/quality stakeholders across a distributed, international team.**


**What You'll Need**

- **3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Statistician, or Quantitative Analyst.**

- **Strong background in statistical analysis and hypothesis testing — comfortable choosing and applying the right test (e.g., distributional comparison tests) to determine whether two groups genuinely differ.**

- **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including standard statistical/analysis libraries.**

- **Demonstrated experience distinguishing genuine patterns from noise or drift in large, messy, human-generated datasets.**

- **Experience with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Data Studio).**

- **Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with short sprint cycles.**

- **Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable producing clear write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.**


**Nice to Have**

- **Experience with anomaly and drift detection on human-rated, crowdsourced, or annotation-based datasets.**

- **Prior experience in a data quality, trust & safety, content moderation, or crowdsourced-data environment.**

- **Familiarity with cohort or segmentation profiling techniques for large populations.**


**Project Overview**

**Location: Remote from Finland**

**Type: Full-time, fixed-term engagement of approximately 6 months, with potential to extend based on program needs.**

**WE OFFER**

- **Occupational health care at Terveystalo private clinic**

- **Multicultural environment/diversity and inclusiveness**

- **Charity & well-being activities**

- **Company events**

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

jobs.title: Skal du have en plads bag rattet i en af Aarhus’ ambulancer?
jobs.description:
Præhospitalet søger lige nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være en del den regionale ambulancetjeneste i Aarhusområdet. 

Du får hjemmebase på Præhospitalets største base på Bautavej i Aarhus V, hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt, kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har en ledig stilling i DAN-vagtrul til besættelse 1. november 2026, eller efter aftale. Her får du 12-timers vagter i rækkefølgen 6-18, 11-23, 18-06 og 5 fridøgn

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet paramediciner eller ambulancebehandler med autorisation. Du skal være fagligt velfunderet og opdateret inden for dit felt, og du skal have vist, at du tager ansvar for egen faglig udvikling og uddannelse.

Du kommer til at indgå i en organisation, der har fokus på både at løse de daglige opgaver, og hvor opgaverne er under fortsat udvikling. Vi håber, at du vil bidrage til en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret samarbejdskultur – på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Der vil således blive lagt vægt på dine evner til at samarbejde og til at bidrage til et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab i ambulancerne og i Præhospitalet som helhed. 

Du skal have kørekort kategori B og C. 

Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Præhospitalet har ansvaret for det præhospitale område i Region Midtjylland, og vores hovedopgave og vision er ”at sikre rette hjælp i rette tid til alle patienter”. Præhospitalet har som de øvrige hospitaler i regionen både drifts-, behandlings-, uddannelses-, kvalitetssikrings- og forskningsmæssige opgaver. I Præhospitalet møder du kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, og fælles for alle er, at vi stræber efter at gøre det bedste for patienterne.

I Præhospitalet lægger vi vægt på høj faglighed, uddannelse og udvikling. Det håber vi også, at du gør, for kompetencevedligehold og efteruddannelse bliver en lige så fast del af dit arbejde som udrykning og behandling af patienter. Derfor skal du også selv have et ønske om at styrke din egen faglighed og udvikling. Det gør du selvfølgelig ikke alene – for vi hjælper og støtter hinanden, og der er kort vej fra medarbejdere til ledelsen. Vi vil gerne være en attraktiv og rummelig arbejdsplads, og du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og meget gerne bidrage til det fælles arbejdsmiljø. 

Du bliver ansat i Præhospitalets afdeling for ambulancer og akutlægebiler. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsledelse, som består af en ambulancechef og en cheflæge, samt en funktionsledelse bestående af 11 funktionsledere. Funktionslederne varetager personaleledelsen af ambulancepersonalet samt den daglige drift.

Du kommer til at referere til funktionsleder Morten Herlev.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst med FOA.


Yderligere information
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at skrive eller ringe til:
Funktionsleder Morten Herlev
Mail: M.Herlev@rm.dk 
Tlf.: 51152151

Du kan finde flere oplysninger om Præhospitalet her Præhospitalet

Sådan søger du
Du søger nemt stillingen via linket "send ansøgning" nederst på siden. Her bliver du bedt om at udfylde nogle oplysninger om dig selv (navn, adresse mv.) samt vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV.

Ansættelsesproces
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 24. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. august på Olof Palmes Allé i Aarhus N.

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.description:

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu aktiivinen myyntityö rempseällä ja iloisella asenteella myymälän puolella sekä muut myymälän avustavat työt, kuten esimerkiksi hyllytys ja myymälän siisteyden ylläpito. Tehtävässä pärjää henkilö, joka pystyy toimimaan ajottaisen kiireenkin keskellä ripeästi sekä vastavuoroisesti hiljaisina aikoina työskentelemään aktiivisesti.

Asiakkaamme tarjoaa sinulle huipputyöporukan lisäksi täydet työtunnit ja työpaikan ainutlaatuisen tuotevalikoiman parissa!
