jobs.title: Go-to-Market Responsible
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Lead Naval Architect - Conceptual Design
jobs.description:
Shape the next generation of vessel concepts

Do you want to take a leading role in defining future vessel designs for demanding clients across specialized vessel segments?

At Vard Design, you will work at the very front of the design process – where the most important decisions are made. As Lead Naval Architect in Conceptual Design, you will drive the development of new vessel concepts, balancing performance, cost and sustainability, and play a key role in winning new projects.

We also have a core team of supporting specialists with long experience and in-depth skills and competence, enabling and amplifying the Lead Naval Architect capacity. We succeed as a team!

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 

So – what are you waiting for? 


Your role

You will combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and leadership in early-phase projects:

  • Lead concept development for complex vessel designs across selected segments
  • Act as the technical lead towards clients in the conceptual phase
  • Drive key design decisions and trade-offs (performance, cost, sustainability)
  • Work closely with Sales to develop strong and competitive technical proposals
  • Facilitate and participate in client workshops and concept discussions
  • Coordinate input from multi-disciplinary teams across VARD
  • Contribute to research & innovation by integrating new technologies and zero-emission solutions
You will have a visible and influential role, both internally and externally, and contribute directly to shaping VARD’s future project portfolio.

 

Qualifications
  • Strong understanding of vessel design trade-offs and performance drivers
  • Ability to lead discussions and make decisions in complex, multi-disciplinary environments
  • Relevant higher education, i.e. Naval Architecture, Engineering
  • Knowledge of certain vessel segments is an advantage
  • Being able to express yourself fluently in English (both written and spoken)


VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Enjoys taking ownership and driving progress in early-phase design
  • Combines analytical thinking with creativity
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Thrives in a collaborative and fast-paced environment
  • Is motivated by delivering high-quality solutions to demanding clients
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you
  • The opportunity to influence vessel concepts at the earliest and most critical stage
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage and subsidized internet at home 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

jobs.title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology project
jobs.description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.

Job description

Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.

You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.

You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.

Your primary tasks and areas of responsibility:

  • Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos

  • In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor

  • In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos

  • In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC

  • Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC

  • Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables

  • Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials

Required skills and experience

The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.

Key skills include:

  • Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance

  • Strong organizational, planning and time management skills

  • Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor

  • Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions

  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams

  • At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor

  • Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

 Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470 . We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

jobs.title: Associate Professor / Professor in Sport Nutrition
jobs.description:
The position

A full-time position as Associate Professor / Professor in Sport Nutrition, with a particular focus on performance nutrition, is available at the Department of Physical Performance at the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences (NIH) from December 2026 or soon thereafter. 

The position is closely linked to the establishment of a new Master program in Sport Nutrition starting in August 2026, where the successful candidate is expected to play a central role in program development, teaching, and supervision.

The Department of Physical Performance has a long history of basic and applied research, focusing on biological effects of physical training from molecule to integrated physiology. 

The research spans fields such as:

  • exercise physiology
  • biomechanics
  • nutrition
  • and sport-specific performance

often conducted in close collaboration with national and international sport federations and industry partners. 


Competence requirements

The department is seeking a highly qualified and motivated candidate to contribute to teaching, research, and academic leadership within sport nutrition, particularly in relation to nutrition for performance, training adaptation, and athlete health.

The successful candidate is expected to have a strong international research profile and documented expertise in areas such as:

  • Applied sport nutrition for athletic performance, including nutrition strategies for training, competition, and recovery
  • Energy availability, metabolism, and body composition in athletes
  • Dietary assessment methods and nutritional interventions in sport settings
  • Physiological and/or molecular responses to nutrition in relation to performance and training adaptations
  • Collaboration with athletes, teams, or sport federations in applied performance contexts

Experience with advanced methodologies (e.g., metabolic measurements, biomarker analysis, body composition techniques such as DXA, or dietary tracking technologies) will be considered an advantage. Strong competence in statistical analysis and data interpretation is required.

The candidate must document:

  • A strong record of high-quality scientific publications
  • Experience in teaching and supervision at bachelor’s, master’s, and preferably PhD level
  • Experience in research collaboration, including interdisciplinary work and external partnerships

The successful applicant is expected to:

  • Play a central role in the development of the sports nutrition research field at the institution
  • Contribute actively to interdisciplinary collaboration within the department
  • Participate in teaching and course development at undergraduate and graduate levels
  • Supervise bachelor, master, and PhD students
  • Have a PhD (or equivalent) in sport nutrition, human nutrition, exercise physiology, or a closely related field is required.

For appointment as Professor, additional emphasis will be placed on:

  • Extensive academic leadership and supervision experience
  • A substantial and sustained record of high-impact research
  • Proven ability to attract external research funding
  • International recognition within the field

A prerequisite for permanent employment is documented basic pedagogical competence (university teaching certification). Applicants who do not meet this requirement at the time of hiring must obtain it within two years.


Selection criteria

Applicants will be assessed based on:

  • Quality, relevance, and impact of scientific work
  • Teaching experience and supervision at all levels
  • Experience with external collaboration and applied sport contexts
  • Ability to attract external funding and disseminate research
  • Interpersonal and communication skills

Proficiency in oral and written English is required. Applicants who do not speak a Scandinavian language must acquire Norwegian language skills at level B2 within three years.


The application
  • Applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. By the application deadline, please upload the following documents together with your application: 
  • Application letter 
  • CV (including teaching and supervision experience and the name and contact information of at least three references) 
  • A complete list of publications 
  • Copies of certificates/diplomas (including formal education in pedagogics, if applicable) 
  • A statement of future research plans and information about research activities 
  • Teaching qualifications and management experience. 

The Application must be in English. 

If the applicant wants other material to be considered in the evaluation (publications and other documentation of research and teaching qualifications, as well as management experience), such material must be clearly specified and available electronically.


Working conditions
  • Salary is offered according to the Norwegian State pay scale (employment code 1011 for Associate Professor / 1013 for Professor), on a scale, for associate professor from NOK 790 000 to 890 000, for professor from NOK 890 000 to 1 000 000. For particularly well-qualified candidates, a higher salary may be considered. 
  • The appointment will be made according to terms applying to civil servants. 
  • NIH is a member of the Norwegian State Pension Fund.
  • Working place is Department of Physical Performance at NIH.
  • Excellent training facilities, corporate sports team, and opportunities for training during working hours.
  • Immediate proximity to the subway, as well as parking, and locked bicycle parking.

Other information

Selected candidates will be interviewed. 

Inclusion and diversity are strengths, and NIH has a personnel policy goal of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, NIH seeks employees with diverse skills, subject combinations, life experiences, and perspectives.

If you are a qualified applicant with a disability, a gap in your CV, or an immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box in the job applicant portal for this. NIH will invite at least one applicant for an interview if they are qualified, and if you get the job, we will strive to accommodate any needs you may have. The ticking is used solely for anonymized statistics, apart from selecting the right candidate.

According to the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. In our recruitment system, applicants will be given the opportunity to request to be exempt from public access, but it is up to the employer to determine whether the request shall be approved or not. If the applicant's desire to be exempt from public access is not approved by the employer, the applicant will be notified so that he/she can withdraw the application.


Kontaktinformasjon

Interested applicants are advised to contact the academic community in preparing the application. 
Further details can be obtained by contacting:

  • Head of Department, professor Truls Raastad, tel. +47 91368896,  trulsr@nih.no 

For questions regarding submitting an application or about the recruitment system Jobbnorge, please contact senior adviser HR, Bente Johansen-Aarbostad, bentejoh@nih.no


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The Norwegian School of Sport Sciences (NIH) is a specialized university and serves as the premier education and research institution of sport science in the Nordic countries. Our mission is to educate, investigate and present a broad range of topics within theoretical and practical sport science. Our Bachelor's degree, Master's degree and PhD programmes aim to be of great relevance.

NIH has approximately 2300 students and a staff of 240 in four departments,  four research centres, six administrative units and a library. 

The campus and sports facilities are located near Sognsvann. 

For more information on NIH, visit http://www.nih.no

jobs.title: Chaufførafløser - STARK Næstved
jobs.description:
Vil du sikre effektiv varelevering og være del af et professionelt fællesskab, der bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres? STARK Næstved søger en engageret Chauffør-afløser til at forme vores fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.

 

Din rolle som Chauffør

Du bliver en del af lager- og logistikken i STARK Næstved, hvor vi er 18 dedikerede medarbejdere, som målrettet arbejder med distribution og håndtering af byggematerialer til professionelle håndværkere, virksomheder og private. Som en del af lager- og logistikteamet hos STARK Næstved vil du:

  • Levere varer med STARK lastvogn med kran (8-25 TM), herunder læsse og aflæsse med truck. Dette medfører at du har kørekort til lastbil (C), krancertifikat (D), truckcertifikat og EU-kvalifikationsbevis.

  • Sikre god service ved levering til både store byggeprojekter og private kunder.

  • Repræsentere STARK i lokalområdet.

  • Overholde sikkerhedsstandarder og kvalitetskrav.

  • Samarbejde tæt med kollegaer for optimal planlægning og rettidig levering.

Vores nye Chauffør

Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som Chauffør er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde

  • Er dygtig til at organisere og planlægge og kan møde kunderne med en positiv og venlig tilgang.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært. Selvom erfaring med distributionskørsel og branchekendskab kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med transport, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 og vi håber, at du kan starte snarest eller senest d. 1. Oktober 2026.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Næstved via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Næstved som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef René Boss Selliah på telefon +45 2892 0788.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

 

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. jobs.title: Johtaja (Sairaanhoitaja), Kankaanpään Vanhustentalosäätiö sr, Ryhmäkoti Kanerva, Tapalankatu 20 b
jobs.description:
Etsimme Kankaanpään vanhustentalosäätiön Ryhmäkoti Kanervaan johtaja (sairaanhoitaja) sijaista vanhempainvapaan ajaksi. Sijaisuus jatkuu mahdollisesti myös hoitovapaan ajan. Sijaisuuden kesto 1-2 vuotta.

Ryhmäkoti Kanerva on 10-12 paikkainen tehostetun palveluasumisen yksikkö muistisairaille ikäihmisille. Tavoitteenamme on asukaslähtöinen laadukas hoito ja huolenpito kodinomaisessa ja turvallisessa ympäristössä.

Olet aktiivisesti sitoutunut ylläpitävään hoitotyöhön, sekä sinulla on halu kehittää omaa osaamistasi vanhustyössä. Pystyt myös työskentelemään tiiviissä työryhmässä. Tehtävään kuluu Ryhmäkoti Kanervan johtajana sekä sairaanhoitajana toimiminen. Sinulla on iäkkäiden- ja muistisairaiden lääkehoidon osaamista, sairaanhoitajan koulutus sekä lähiesimiestutkinto. Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, tiimihenkisyyttä ja oma-aloitteista vastuuntuntevaa otetta asukaslähtöiseen hoivatyöhön ikäihmisten parissa.

Työsuhde on määräaikainen. Edellytämme hakijalta terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöstä annetun lain 559/1994 mukaista laillistusta Suomessa. Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä voimassa olevat lääkeluvat (Vähintään Lop teoria ja laskut, PKV, Rokote) sekä hygieniapassia.Tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen tehtävään valitulta lainsäädännön (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta) määräämällä tavalla ennen työsuhteen solmimista. Rikosrekisteriote ei saa olla 6kk vanhempi.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot sekä palkkaus määräytyvät voimassaolevan SOSTES mukaisesti. Työaikamuotona on 1-vuorotyötä.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja teemme valinnan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työ alkaa 5.10.2026.

jobs.title: Produksjonsarbeider i fiskeindustri
jobs.description:
Vi søker produksjonsmedarbeidere i fabrikken vår på Ellingsøya

Du vil være involvert i de ulike prosessene i klippfiskproduksjon. Vi er ute etter motiverte personer, som trives med tungt fysisk arbeid, og som er ansvarsbevisste og samarbeidsvillige. Du må kunne kommunisere enten på norsk eller engelsk.

Det vil være en fordel å ha truckførerbevis, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi har behov for noen som kan tiltre i en 100% stilling - med arbeidstid 07:10-15:10 mandag-fredag. Noe overtid må påregnes i perioder. Det er en fordel å også disponere bil, med tanke på arbeidstid og arbeidsplassens beliggenhet.

Vi kan tilby en midlertidig arbeidsavtale, men det finnes muligheter for fast ansettelse. Konkurransedyktig lønn.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad. Vi vil kalle inn søkere til intervju på Ellingsøy.

We are looking for production workers for our factory in Ellingsøy

You will be involved in the various processes in the production of salted and dried fish. We are looking for motivated people, who enjoy a hard physical job. Someone who are responsible and willing to cooperate with others. You must be able to communicate either in Norwegian or English.

It would be an advantage to have a forklift driver's license, but it is not a requirement.

We need someone who can work a 100% position - with working hours 07-15 Monday-Friday. Some overtime must be expected in periods. It is an advantage to also have a car at your disposal, because of working hours and the location of the workplace. We can offer a temporary employment contract, but there are opportunities for permanent employment. Competitive wages.

Looking forward to seeing your application. We will ask applicants to come in for an interview in Ellingsøy.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jacob Bjørge AS er en bedrift på Ellingsøy som produserer og eksporterer klippfisk. Vi er en familiebedrift, som har holdt til her i 89 år. Å produsere det tradisjonsrike produktet klippfisk - salta og tørka hvitfisk - tar tid og krever kompetanse. Det er hardt fysisk arbeid, og er avhengig av godt samarbeid.

jobs.title: Sesongjobb 2026: Renholder for fritidsboliger i Hallingdal
jobs.description:
Vil du ha en aktiv vinterjobb i vakre Hallingdal? Vi vokser søker pålitelige og nøyaktige renholdere til vask av fritidsboliger vinteren 2026/2027. Du får jobbe selvstendig og i team og bidra til å gi gjestene en førsteklasses opplevelse.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som er effektiv, pliktoppfyllende og nøyaktig. Du trives med fysisk arbeid, liker å jobbe selvstendig og har et øye for detaljer. Du må ha bil, førerkort klasse B og være tilgjengelig for jobb i vinter. Erfaring fra renhold er en fordel, men ikke et krav - opplæring gis.
Mulighet for fast ansettelse.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som sesongansatt renholder vil du ha ansvar for vask av fritidsboliger i Hallingdal. Arbeidet inkluderer grundig rengjøring av kjøkken, bad, soverom og fellesarealer, samt rydding og forberedelse til nye gjester. Arbeidet skjer etter faste rutiner og med støtte fra vårt driftssystem.

Vi tilbyr

  • En aktiv og variert sommerjobb i vakre omgivelser

  • Opplæring og støtte fra erfarent team

  • God struktur og oversikt via egen app

  • Fast lønn per time og tillegg i helger og høysesong

  • Kjøregodtgjørelse

  • Et inkluderende og uformelt arbeidsmiljø

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hallingdal Rental HUB er en lokal og profesjonell aktør innen utleie av fritidsboliger. Vi håndterer hele utleieprosessen for hytte- og boligeiere i Hallingdal - fra markedsføring og gjestekommunikasjon til renhold, nøkkelhåndtering og drift. Målet vårt er å skape trygge, lønnsomme og sømløse utleieopplevelser for både eiere og gjester. Vi er et voksende selskap med base på Gol, og vi kombinerer lokal tilstedeværelse med moderne driftssystemer og høy servicegrad.

jobs.title: Försäljingsförhandlare
jobs.description:
Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är ett inhemskt vitamin försäljningshus. Vi säljer hälsoprodukter som möjliggör en hälsosammare och bättre livsstil. Vi rekryterar nu nya heltids arbetare till vårt försäljningsteam.

Du behöver ingen tidigare arbetserfarenhet, vi utbildar var och en med vår 30-åriga arbetserfarenhet och yrkeskunnighet. För oss är ålder bara en siffra och i vårt arbetsteam erbjuds bra arbetsro för såväl ungdomar som seniorer.

Heltidsarbetare arbetar 7 timmar varje dag antingen morgon- eller kvällsskift. Till arbetsskiften tar vi hänsyn till varje arbetares personliga behov och du får också själv vara med och påverka dina skift.

Vi skolar varje arbetare enskilt och du får personlig rådgivning under hela din arbetstid. Vår personals trivsel och välbefinnande är viktig för oss så vi försäkrar oss om att alla arbetstagare trivs arbeta hos oss.

Om du söker en ny riktning i livet och vill lära dig ett nytt yrke, så erbjuder vi också möjlighet för läroavtalsutbildning. Du får både lön och arbetserfarenhet, under merkonom-utbildningen.

Kotimainen Hyvinvointitukku är en del av HL-Family Oy. HL-Family Oy belönades med Platinum AAA-certifikatet, vilket betyder att vi har AAA-klassats 10 år i rad. Sama certifikatet har bara delats ut till mindre av en tusendel av finländska företag.

Vi ringer upp alla som skickar in en ansökan. Om du tar kontakt per telefon tar kontorets förman gärna emot ditt samtal. Du kan skicka en friformad ansökan direkt till vår e-post eller fylla i ansöknings-formuläret på vår webbplats https://hyvinvointitukku.fi/rekrytointi/.

jobs.title: HSE Supervisor (Construction Site – Microsoft Data Centre, Espoo, Finland)
jobs.description:
**Location:** Espoo, Finland

**Company:** Litana Finland Oy – Subcontractor at Microsoft Data Centre Project

**Position:** HSE Supervisor

**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site

**Contract Duration:1-year fixed-term contract** (with possible extension)

**Start**: September 1, 2026

**About the Role**

We are looking for an HSE Supervisor to join our team at the Microsoft Data Centre construction project in Espoo, Finland. The role involves ensuring compliance with HSE standards, coordinating on-site safety activities, and promoting a strong safety culture. The HSE Supervisor reports to the **HSE Manager** and works closely with site management and subcontractors to maintain a safe workplace.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Monitor and enforce compliance with project-specific HSE policies, procedures, and applicable local regulations.

- Conduct regular site inspections, risk assessments, toolbox talks, and incident investigations.

- Ensure safe working practices, particularly in electrical and other high-risk activities.

- Keep HSE documentation and records up-to-date according to project requirements.

- Promote health, safety, and environmental awareness among workers.

- Cooperate with the main contractors HSE representatives.


**Requirements**

- Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimum 1 year of experience in HSE roles within the construction or similar industry.

- Knowledge of electrical safety principles – strong advantage.

- Familiarity with applicable Finnish legislation and international (EU) safety standards.

- Holding an Electrical Safety Card (SFS 6002), Occupational Safety Card (TTK), and First Aid certification is an advantage.

- Confident computer literacy (MS Office).

- Good communication skills in English and Russian – both written and spoken (required).


**We Offer**

- Salary according to Collective Agreement for the Technology Industry.

- Opportunity to work on an international construction project and gain valuable experience.

- Supportive and safety-driven work environment.

- Professional development and training opportunities.


Applicants must have the right to work in Finland.

Russian language skills are an advantage.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
jobs.description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.title: Autonasentaja
jobs.description:
Meille autonasentajaksi?

Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen ammattitaitoista ja ahkeraa autonasentajaa, jolla on hyvä työasenne. Pystyt huoltamaan ja korjaamaan itsenäisesti henkilö- ja pakettiautoja. Sinulta onnistuu vianhaku, diagnosointi sekä haastavammatkin huolto- ja korjaustyöt.

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- autoalan koulutusta ja vähintään 1 vuoden työkokemusta alalta
- omatoimisuutta, huolellisuutta sekä tehokasta otetta työntekoon
- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja joustavuutta
- Autofutur-ohjelmiston käyttökokemus on eduksi

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi
- mukavan ja rennon työporukan, jossa on helppo pyytää työkaverilta tarvittaessa apua
- kilpailukykyisen ja oikeudenmukaisen palkan (2 550 - 3000 euroa/kk)
- säännöllisen työajan ma-pe klo 8.00-16.30
- kattavan tapaturmavakuutuksen koskien myös vapaa-aikana sattuvia vahinkoja
- mahdollisuuden halutessasi korjata ja fiksata omia autojasi tiloissamme viikonloppuisin

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot itsestäsi sekä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Eero Eloranta p. 045 872 3934, sähköposti: eero.eloranta@tampereenautolasipalvelu.fi.

Keitä me olemme?

Olemme paikallinen perheyritys. Meille on tärkeintä työntekijöidemme hyvä viihtyvyys sekä erinomainen asiakaspalvelu laadukkaan työnjäljen lisäksi. Kuulumme valtakunnallisiin Autofit ja First Stop -ketjuihin, jotka takaavat mahdollisuudet esim. lisäkoulutuksiin työntekijöiden oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Työllistämme tällä hetkellä neljä autonasentajaa, kaksi työnjohtajaa ja kaksi tuulilasiasentajaa. Yrityksen virallinen nimi on Tampereen Autolasipalvelu Oy, joka on toiminut jo vuodesta 1993 alkaen. Yrittäjinä ovat toimineet vuodesta 2011 alkaen ylöjärveläiset Eero ja Katri Eloranta.

Autofit Epilän Autohuollosta lisätietoja: www.epilanautohuolto.fi

Suomalaisen Työn Liitto myönsi 15.12.2022 yrityksellemme Avainlippu-tunnuksen, joka on merkki suomalaisesta työstä. Meille on tärkeää toimia paikallisesti ja luoda työpaikkoja Suomeen.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Director (m/f)
jobs.description:
Client Relationship Director

In Summary:

• Core focus on attracting, retaining and growing the book of strategic Tier-1 & 2 clients
• Accountable for the successful execution of the client strategy
• Ensures productive & profitable outcome for the business, in line with set new business conversion, revenue and profitability targets
• Creates a compelling & differentiating client specific value proposition
• Achieves deep understanding of client's strategic priorities, goals, challenges & specific expectations

In detail:

• Build, maintain and expand connectivity with key decision-makers within designated clients
• Establish and maintain clear communication channels with designated clients and have thorough understanding of client's strategic priorities and needs
• Develop and maintain Client Account Plans setting out our approach to maximising revenue growth opportunities with each client through up-sell and commercial-collaboration
• Arrange and lead Strategic Relationship Review with top group clients, ensure a co-ordinated approach across the delivery team and act as a central point of senior escalation
• Assumes overall responsibility for the relationship with the client (globally where applicable)
• Co-ordinates new business opportunities to drive win rate for the existing book of clients
• Responsible for engaging our internal legal and BI teams and overseeing the completion of all client legal documents and agreements including fee agreements, Service Level Agreements, fee quotes, Administration Agreements etc.
• Ensure Client Services Director and operational teams run servicing reviews and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) against SLA
• Maintain internal CRM tools updated with commercial activities, account plans and client and business partner interaction, ensure accurate and timely pipeline management and actions taken to ensure an accurate client relationship management
• Ultimately responsible for client attrition, working in close cooperation with CSDs on drafting and execution of client remediation plans, keeps track of Client at Risk, respect internal escalation protocols and action relevant stakeholders for a proper remediation
• Monitor and remediate long-term profitability of client relationships
• Develop and implement initiatives to remediate less profitable client relationships to acceptable standards
• Understanding new services/developments within IQ-EQ and responsible for identifying and maximising business development opportunities within client portfolio
• Actively monitor and identify key areas and ensure operations team have appropriate remediation plans in place to address these
• Escalate ongoing or significant risks to client revenue appropriately
• Cash collection: ensure lockup days of client portfolio does not exceed 60 days (definition of lock up period as provided by IQ-EQ finance)
• Play an active role in developing and executing initiatives to grow the portfolio of clients and grow revenue per client
• Represent and promote IQ-EQ as “one company” with an entrepreneurial spirit.
• Foster a culture of collaboration, respect and mutual engagement

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Promote actively Commercial Collaboration within the group between jurisdictions, segments and across our technology solutions
• Build a strong external network with Business Partners and industry associations
• Actively participate in business development and Thought Leadership events and represent IQ-EQ externally
• Participate actively in client pitching processes together with global and local commercial teams and ensure a seamless and effective onboarding process alongside Business Implementation team
• Act as an escalation point for complex matters and complaints and pro-actively work together with Client Services Directors, Head of Delivery and Subject Matter Expert to resolve them. Promote a feedback culture aiming at continuous service improvement
• Manage the financial and contractual relationship with the client. Reviews/renegotiates agreements if and when needed. Analysis of client / account performance to improve the relationship and profitability (lockup days, account profitability, scope, revenue trends, competitive analysis, perceived quality and account mapping.)
• Ultimate escalation point for cash collection
• Signals (potential) risk issues and musters the appropriate company resources to mitigate such risks or to escalate in the event such mitigation efforts are ineffective or in the event the risk is too high and requires executive involvement or warning

Deliverables (KPI's)

• Revenue growth generated in line with targets
• New busines growth in line with conversion target
• Outbound commercial collaboration in line with target leads and opportunities generated
• Client churn other than natural EOL (End Of Life).
• Lock-up period below 60 days
• Client profitability in line with target
• Ongoing pipeline management and compliance with sales process

The Department of Life Sciences and Medicine (DLSM) belongs to the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine of the University of Luxembourg. We combine basic and translational, biomolecular and computational research to address critical questions in human health and disease with a main focus on cancer biology. We investigate mechanisms that govern tumor initiation, migration and invasion, metastasis, cell cycle control, the tumor microenvironment and drug resistance by using a combination of experimental in vitro, in vivo and in silico approaches. Next to its research mission, DLSM is coordinating all teaching programs in Life Sciences, Medicine, Nursing and Allied Health Professions.
Health and Medicine are a strategic priority of the University of Luxembourg and are presently in an ambitious phase of development. This strategic expansion requires additional expertise in teaching pharmacology across various fields, including Medicine, Life sciences, Nursing, and Allied Health Professions.

The candidate will additionally play a key role in shaping our educational mission by delivering high-quality teaching in pharmacology at the bachelor, master, and doctoral programmes, with a special focus on Medicine and Life Sciences.

The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in histology (and histopathology) at the bachelor's level and within medical specialization programmes, while also offering access to state-of-the-art infrastructure to support high level research in related fields. About the FHSE

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) at the University of Luxembourg brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed. The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society.

Your role

The cohesion of liberal societies increasingly depends on high-quality, participatory human services spanning social, educational, and cultural domains. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. This position will contribute to the development of digital and face-to-face methods for public involvement, by shaping the theories, methodologies, and tools that underpin participatory knowledge production in human services. Active in research, innovation and teaching, the position holder will, in particular:

• Analyse and develop innovative approaches to service user engagement, public outreach, and multi-stakeholder dialogue focusing on unequal power relations and conﬂicting interests. These approaches should combine data-intensive digital tools with face-to-face interventions, enabling exchanges between human service providers and hard-to-reach populations. Examples include collaborative digital platforms, co-creative living labs, interactive exhibitions, and multisensorial participatory interventions
• Organize participatory events and lead the development of the department's outreach initiative ALICES (Agora Luxembourgeoise partICipative de l'intErvention Sociale) - a living lab launched in 2023 that engages with Luxembourg's human services sector
• Design and theorise participatory interventions and public outreach within the context of human services as well as in empirical research methods
• Teach conceptual and methodological courses in the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives (BSSE), playing a key a key role in its ongoing development and expansion. The postholder will also have the opportunity to contribute to the construction of a projected new Master's programme and to teach within the doctoral and lifelong learning programmes of the university

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Dr. Boris Traue, Director of the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives, Email: boris.traue@uni.lu

Day-to-day tasks include conducting job evaluations, reviewing and updating compensation structures, overseeing benefits administration, and ensuring compliance with local labor laws and company policies. The role also involves analyzing market data, preparing reports and recommendations for leadership, coordinating with HR and finance teams on payroll-related matters, and communicating compensation and benefits policies clearly to employees. The Compensation Benefits Manager will work closely with business leaders to align reward strategies with organizational goals and support continuous improvement of HR processes.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in compensation management and compensation structures, with the ability to design and optimize competitive reward frameworks.
  • Experience in benefits administration and employee benefits, including selection, implementation, and communication of benefit programs.
  • Proficiency in job evaluation and role benchmarking to ensure internal equity and external market competitiveness.
  • Solid understanding of Cambodian labor law, regulations, and compliance requirements related to compensation and benefits.
  • Advanced skills in data analysis, HR metrics, and use of HRIS or related software; proficiency in Excel or similar tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and confidentiality.
  • Bachelorâs degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field; professional HR or compensation certification is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in compensation and benefits roles, preferably within multi-sector or fast-growing organizations.

jobs.title: Kokenut huskyopas Pure Lapland / Wild Husky Rovaniemi Oylle
jobs.description:
**Kokenut huskyopas – tule mukaan Lapin talvikauteen!**

Onko sinulla kokemusta huskyvaljakon ajamisesta ja asiakkaiden opastamisesta? Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**

Työtehtäväsi

Huskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen

- moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta

- asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin

- huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät

- varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito

- asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.

**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

jobs.title: Job i Malaga? Book et kald med os i dag og hør alt om vores danske kontor og fællesskab i Malaga centrum.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at arbejde i solen? ☀️ Vi søger nye kollegaer til vores danske kontor i Malaga. Book et kald med os i dag, så tager vi en uforpligtende snak om hvad vi kan tilbyde.

Vil du være en del af et dynamisk og socialt team, hvor du kan opbygge stærke relationer og gøre en positiv forskel? Så har vi plads til dig på vores danske kontor i Malaga!

Vi søger engagerede fundraisere til at kontakte potentielle donorer og præsentere vores NGO-projekter. Dit arbejde vil bidrage til at skabe øget bevidsthed om, hvor lidt der skal til for at gøre en stor forskel. Du vil samarbejde tæt med teamet for at sikre støtte til vores projekter.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast løn efter kvalifikationer og en kontrakt med ordnede forhold.

  • Faste arbejdstider med fri om aftenen og i weekenderne.

  • Betalt frokost på arbejdet.

  • Løbende træning i salgskommunikation og personlig udvikling.

  • Et socialt og støttende arbejdsmiljø med et stærkt fællesskab.

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for salg og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har en passion for velgørenhed og ønsker at gøre en forskel.

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og opbygge relationer.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er også en teamplayer.

  • Du er åben for at lære og udvikle nye færdigheder.

  • Du kan arbejde fuldtid i en periode på minimum 4-6 måneder.

Hvem er vi?

Vores danske kontor i Málaga har eksisteret siden 2012, og vi støtter forskellige NGO-projekter. Kontoret er kendt for sin inkluderende kultur og stærke sammenhold. Her bliver du en del af et team med 50 kollegaer på tværs af aldersgrupper, og du møder alle ansatte i løbet af dagen.

Arbejdsplads og miljø

  • Vi har et inspirerende og socialt arbejdsmiljø med en flad ledelsesstruktur.

  • Fokus på fællesskab, engagement og respekt.

  • Teammøder fyldt med energi og humor.

  • En kultur, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og inklusion.

  • Vi tror på, at alle kan gøre en forskel!

Vil du være en del af vores team?

Uanset om du allerede bor i Málaga eller overvejer at flytte hertil, så er du velkommen hos os! Kom forbi vores kontor, drik en kop kaffe hvis du er i nærhenden og oplev vores unikke fællesskab. Du er også velkommen til abre at sende en ansøgning og så tager vi en snak med dig om muligheden.

Du kan se kontoret og kulturen på dette link

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?
At tage til udlandet og arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kan være en berigende oplevelse, både personligt og professionelt.

Her er nogle fordele, det kan have for din karriere fremadrettet:

  • Når du arbejder i udlandet, udvider du dine horisonter og får indsigt i forskellige kulturer og arbejdsmetoder.

  • Det gør dig mere åben og fleksibel, hvilket er værdifulde kvaliteter i et globalt arbejdsmarked.

  • Arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kræver stærke kommunikationsevner og evnen til at overbevise og engagere potentielle donorer. Disse kompetencer er eftertragtede i mange erhverv, da de viser, at du kan formidle budskaber effektivt og skabe positive relationer.

  • Derudover skaber du et internationalt netværk af kontakter og forbindelser, som kan være nyttige for din fremtidige karriere.

  • At have erfaring fra udlandet viser også, at du er initiativrig og villig til at tage chancer, hvilket kan imponere fremtidige arbejdsgivere.

  • Fundraising-arbejde kan føre til muligheder inden for marketing, salg, og nonprofit-organisationer, hvor dine kommunikative færdigheder og evnen til at opbygge relationer er afgørende.

  • Endelig viser det, at du kan tilpasse dig forskellige arbejdsmiljøer og håndtere udfordringer med positivt engagement. Dette gør dig til en attraktiv kandidat på arbejdsmarkedet, da virksomheder ofte søger medarbejdere, der kan navigere i en global kontekst og bidrage til deres vækst og udvikling.

Vil du med på holdet? Så grib chancen og ansøg nu! Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

jobs.title: Huoltoneuvoja
jobs.description:
Haemme kasvavaan joukkoomme **Huoltoneuvojaa**, jolla on jo kokemusta korjaamotoiminnasta ja joka viihtyy monipuolisessa asiakaspalvelu- ja työnjohtoroolissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat autohuollon asiakaspalvelu, korjaamon työnjohto, ajanvaraukset, varaosatilaukset sekä päivittäinen yhteistyö asiakkaiden, asentajien ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaan huoltokokemus on sujuva alusta loppuun.

**Meistä**

Autosta Oy on Espoon Muuralassa toimiva autohuolto- ja rengasalan yritys, jonka lisäksi harjoitamme kuljetusliiketoimintaa. Olemme osa arvostettuja **Mekonomen Autohuolto- ja Vianor-ketjuja**, mikä tarjoaa asiakkaillemme laadukkaat palvelut ja työntekijöillemme vahvan tuen päivittäiseen tekemiseen.

Liiketoimintamme kasvaa jatkuvasti, ja etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ammattilaista mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuttamme.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- Kokemusta autohuollon huoltoneuvojan tehtävistä tai korjaamotyöskentelystä

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti kiireisessäkin työympäristössä

- Sujuvaa tietokoneen ja erilaisten ohjelmistojen käyttöä

- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sekä asiakaspalveluun riittävää englannin kielen osaamista

- Positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Kiinnostusta autoalaa ja sen jatkuvaa kehittymistä kohtaan

- Autoalan koulutus, tekninen osaaminen, sekä kokemus esimerkiksi AutoFutur korjaamojärjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

- Vakituisen työpaikan kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaasi ja yrityksen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

- Joustavan työnantajan, joka arvostaa työntekijöidensä panosta

- Hyvät henkilöstöedut

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi autoalan ammattilaisena


**Arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Täysipäiväinen työ on mahdollista toteuttaa myös neljän arkipäivän työviikkona hieman pidemmillä työpäivillä. Lisäksi työskentelemme ainoastaan arkipäivisin, joten viikonloput jäävät vapaaksi.**

Meillä työtä tehdään hyvässä hengessä ja yhdessä joukkueena. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, reipasta asennetta ja halua palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

**Hae mukaan tiimiimme**

Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi, jotta hakemus tulee huomioiduksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Santtu. Arjen kiireiden vuoksi pyydämme mahdolliset puhelintiedustelut arkipäivisin klo 17 jälkeen.

Hakemukset Santtu Niemiselle osoitteeseen etunimi.sukinimi@autosta.fi ja puhelintiedustelut numerosta nolla neljä nolla 555 29 23.

**Autosta Oy**_Pidetään autot liikkeellä, yhdessä._
