jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotikuntoutus ja turva-auttamistiimi, Kirkkonummi
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia vakituisiin työsuhteisiin Kirkkonummen kotikuntoutustiimiin. Tehtävään kuuluu kotikuntoutuksen lisäksi vuoroja turva-auttamistehtävässä. Työskentelyalue voi tarpeen mukaan muuttua tai laajentua.

Kotikuntoutus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun muassa Läntisen sairaala-alueen, Seniori-infon ja alueellisen kotihoidon kanssa, vastateten sairaalasta kotiutuvien ikääntyneiden kotiutuksista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksesta kotona, turva-auttamisen käynneistä, sekä palvelutarpeen arviosta yhdessä Seniori-infon kanssa.

Lähihoitajan työ kotikuntoutuksessa on asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa itsenäistä, asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Tavoitteena on mahdollistaa asiakkaan toimivaa arkea ja tukea kotona asumista.

Lähihoitajan työhön kuuluvissa turva-auttamisvuoroissa keskeisiä vastuualueita ovat turva-auttamisasiakkaiden hälytystehtävien vastaanotto sähköisen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja vaihtuvien asiakkaiden kotiin jalkautuminen itsenäisesti. Asiakkaan luona tehdään tilannearvio ja arvio tämän kotikuntoisuudesta. Käynnillä annetaan asiakkaan tarvitsema välitön ensiapu ja muu tuki, arvioidaan lisäavun tarve ja tarvittaessa järjestetään se asiakkaalle. Käynneillä on mahdolisuus muiden ammattiryhmien konsutointiin.

Työhön kuuluu myös turvapuhelinten ja muiden turvalaitteiden asennus asiakkaille ja turvalaitteiden toiminnan tarkistaminen.

Kirjaaminen on iso osa niin kotikuntoutuksen kuin turva-auttamipalvelun työtä. Käynneillä tehdään kirjaukset Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmään sekä raportoidaan tarvittaessa eteenpäin toisille ammattilaisille. Yhteistyötä tehdään eri viranomaistahojen, kuten kotihoidon ja sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystyksen kanssa.

Työssä pääsee takuuvarmasti hyödyntämään monipuolisesti lähihoitajan osaamista!

Työssä korostuvat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, vastuullisuus sekä tiimityöskentelytaidot. Työyksikkö ja esihenkilö ovat tukena ja varmistavat, että työ sujuu. Työ on moniammatillista. Tiimiin kuuluu lähihoitajien lisäksi sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, sekä lääkäri.

Työ on jaksotyötä, johon kuuluu aamu- ja iltavuoroja sekä viikonlopputyötä.

Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana, joten haethan pian - odotamme hakemustasi!

Työpaikan osoite: Jokiniityntie 2, 02400 Kirkkonummi
Työaika: 114h 45min/ 3 viikossa
Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Lähihoitajan nimikkeellä toimivalta edellytetään oikeutta käyttää tehtävään soveltuvaa nimikesuojattua ammattinimikettä. Eduksi katsotaan osaamisalana perustason ensihoito, sairaanhoito ja huolenpito tai pelastajatutkinnon perustason ensihoidon suuntautumisvaihtoehto.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- ruotsin kielen taito on eduksi
- ajokortti on pakollinen
- lääkehoitolupa ei ole pakollinen, mutta se tulee suorittaa koeajan puitteissa

Toivomme, että
- ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita
- tunnet sote-alan päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön
- olet yhteistyötaitoinen: kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti ja osaat arvioida asiakkaan tilanteen ja hoidon tarpeen nopeasti
- pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- sinulla on valmius itsenäiseen kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden kotona

Arvostamme
- ensiapuosaamista
- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoitotyöstä ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat
- uusien järjestelmien ketterä käyttöönottokyky
- aiempaa kokemusta työssä tarvittavista järjestelmistä (Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

1.1.2024 lukien tehtävään valitun on esitettävä itseään koskeva lain 741/2023 28 §:n mukainen iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote.


Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard elements will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark. To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations. At the same time, an outfitting team from another department is outfitting the element with more permanent additions. It is up to the Site engineer to assist the production team and to document and verify the activities that are executed. There will be interface with several Supervisors, work preparation of the outfitting and subcontractors.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

▪ Prepare work method statements (WMS) and work procedures (WPR).

▪ Takes an active part in the structural meetings.

▪ Is supportive of Commissioning Engineers and TE Systems execution teams by providing planning, documentation and the necessary equipment.

▪ Ensures a safe working environment through toolbox meetings, pre-start meetings, safety walks and by addressing issues directly.

jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product Engineering
jobs.description:
About Varnish Software

Varnish Software is a Scandinavian-based tech company developing caching technology for some of the world's biggest players in the content delivery market. Our technology helps businesses worldwide improve website performance, deliver video streams, and scale their infrastructure.

About the role 💼

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our new Product Engineering team. While Varnish is known for its general purpose caching engine (OSS and Enterprise), our team is focused on building new products to solve real-world needs, where caching is just one of the components. It’s a bit like developing LEGO sets.

We are currently building a Data Fabric suite of products designed to address infrastructure challenges, including (but not limited to):

  • Virtual Registry: Caching packages, Docker images, and other software artifacts.

  • Artifact Firewall: Preventing and mitigating software supply chain attacks.

  • S3 Cache: On-prem caching of S3-compatible object stores.

  • AI Storage Accelerator: Speed up AI training and inference workloads.

You will have a high degree of technical freedom and ownership, as we prioritize quality over quantity and work on long-term ongoing projects. The solutions you help create will be deployed both on-prem by customers and used to build managed platforms and services.

What You Will Do

We primarily develop our tools in Go, but Rust is becoming increasingly relevant for our critical high-performance components.

You will be building self-hosted, distributed systems that need to deploy across a wide range of customer environments. Your core responsibilities will include:

  • System Architecture & Implementation: You will not just be implementing features, you will participate in architecting the "Data Fabric" suite. This involves solving complex concurrency, networking, and data consistency challenges. It’s a lot of fun!

  • Technical Ownership: We are looking for an engineer who thinks beyond the ticket. You will take ownership of entire components, from the initial RFC/design phase through to implementation and testing.

  • Drive Innovation: You are expected to be a vocal part of the engineering process. We need you to challenge our architectural assumptions, propose alternative technical approaches, and help us avoid local optima in our design decisions.

  • Good Code: You will contribute to a culture of high code quality, writing maintainable, testable code and participating in rigorous code reviews.

Who You Are

We are looking for a developer who is driven by solving problems, not just closing tickets.

  • Solid Engineering Foundation: You have strong experience in backend software development. While our stack is primarily Go, we value deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, concurrency, and distributed systems over specific syntax.

  • Product-Minded: You understand that code is a means to an end. You have enough industry knowledge to understand why we are building these products and can make technical decisions that align with market needs.

  • Innovator & Challenger: You are not afraid to voice a different opinion or challenge architectural decisions. Varnish Software has a flat company structure and thrives on individuals taking ownership.

  • Versatile: You understand the complexities of self-hosted software. You are comfortable navigating the blurry line between application code and the infrastructure it runs on (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux).

  • Self-Driven: You manage your own time effectively, take initiative without waiting for permission, and contribute to a friendly, humble, and collaborative team culture.

About the team 💙

Our Research & Development team develops and maintains the Varnish Software products, which includes Varnish Enterprise, Varnish Controller and Varnish Traffic Router. We're a group of open-minded, friendly, and curious software engineers, eager to exploring and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in content delivery.

We embrace a company culture inspired by innovation and teamwork. For us, a sense of belonging, equality and trust is key for building high performing teams who thrive as professionals and individuals. 

We're based in Oslo, Karlstad and Paris. 

Benefits, Perks & Salary Range 🙌

At our Varnish Software, we believe that a happy and healthy team is the foundation of our success. That's why we offer a range of benefits and perks:

  • Flexible working arrangements 🏡

We know that life doesn't always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. That's why we offer flexible working arrangements to help you balance your professional and personal life. This role requires You to be able to work from the Oslo office (Nydalen) at least once a week.

  • Generous parental pay 🧑‍🍼

We believe in supporting our employees through all life stages, ensuring you can enjoy quality time with your little one without financial worries. Join us and experience a workplace that truly values work-life balance and family wellbeing.

  • Vacation 🏖️

We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation. That's why we offer 26 vacation days, enjoy more time to travel, unwind, and spend quality time with your loved ones.

How to Apply

Eligibility: You must have the legal right to work in Norway or hold unrestricted work authorization within the EU/EEA that allows you to work in Norway at the time of employment. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Ready to join our team?
Simply click the "Apply" button to start your application process. We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to our success. Don’t hesitate - take the first step towards your new career with us today!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Varnish Software creates edge caching and content delivery software that unlocks fast, reliable digital experiences for users and systems.

We’re an inclusive employer; seeing diversity as a strong asset. When we’ve different perspectives and approaches, we grow together to create innovative solutions and contributions to software development and to our customers. With this diversity, we have one thing in common; we’re fun and friendly. And we’re in this together!

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Taux d'activité entre 50% et 80%

Stimuler et soutenir les clients et leurs proches en maintenant au maximum leur autonomie et leur qualité de vie en fonction de leurs capacités

Votre profil et vos compétences  
Certificat d'auxiliaire de santé CRS 120 heures ou certification jugée équivalente (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS) ou volonté de suivre la formation  
Intérêt marqué pour l'âge avancé et le maintien à domicile  
Capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome tout en sachant collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit  
Bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques et la téléphonie mobile  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi  
Les avantages de nous rejoindre  
Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  
L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  
Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  
Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers

We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. jobs.title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.  
“Join an international environment with exciting projects and responsibilities — be proactive, contribute, and grow together with a great team”  
\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen  
Thrive with us  
You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen  
T:  
Want to find out more about us?  
Visit our website Octapharma Career and follow us daily on LinkedIn.  
About Octapharma  
Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. With seven R\&D sites and five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany, and Sweden, Octapharma also operates over 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. With four decades of experience, we are committed to advancing patient care worldwide. jpid5481217jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

Legal Counsel

jobs.title: Conducteur de Travaux - Rénovation & Transformation
jobs.description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Analyser les plans, les dossiers d'exécution et les spécificités liées aux bâtiments existants.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences techniques.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux, les mandataires et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins cinq ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine de la rénovation et de la transformation.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.  
Vous êtes capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution.

Infirmier santé mentale (H/F)  
Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.  
En rejoignant la Fondation Soins Lausanne, vous vous engagez de ère concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.  
Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs.  
Afin de compléter nos équipes, La Fondation Soins Lausanne recherche de suite ou à convenir plusieurs :  
Infirmier santé mentale (H/F)  
Taux d'activité entre 80%  
Contrat fixe à durée indeterminée  
Votre mission  
Accompagner les clients présentant des troubles psychiques ou des maladies psychiatriques dans leur projet de vie à domicile. Travailler dans une optique de partenariat en donnant du sens et de la cohérence tout en collaborant étroitement avec l’entourage et les proches pour développer des liens de confiance  
Elaborer le projet thérapeutique en tenant compte de la complexité des soins et le développer en fonction de l’évolution  
Piloter la prise en charge globale et intégrative des clients tout en s’appuyant sur les intervenant.e.s internes et les équipes interdisciplinaires et en bonne coordination avec les institutions impliquées dans le réseau de soins  
Contribuer activement au maintien à domicile durable des clients par des mesures de prévention et de promotion de la santé tout en tenant compte des besoins individuels avec une prise en charge personnalisée et en favorisant l’autonomie des clients  
Agir en soutien et orientation des équipes interdisciplinaires dans la prise en charge des clients en soins généraux ou en santé mentale  
Participer à des projets de développement et aux groupes de travail autour de l’amélioration continue des prestations de soins en santé mentale dans le domaine des aides et soins à domicile  
Collaborer activement aux activités des équipes interdisciplinaires avec un rôle propre vous permettant de valoriser votre expertise infirmière comme partie prenante à part entière du système de santé  
Votre profil et vos compétences  
Bachelor en soins infirmiers ou titre jugé équivalent (diplôme étranger reconnu par la CRS)  
Expérience minimum de 2 ans dans le domaine psychiatrique et/ou psychogériatrique en Suisse  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social un atout et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Capacité à collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  
Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  
Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi  
Les avantages de nous rejoindre  
Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  
L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  
Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  
Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  
Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  
Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans

jobs.title: Conducteur de Travaux - Terrassement
jobs.description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Terrassement  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à réaliser des projets d'envergure, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés dans le domaine du terrassement et des infrastructures. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de terrassement, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents intervenants.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux et équipements nécessaires.  
Mettre en place et suivre les procédures liées à la qualité, à la sécurité et à l'environnement.  
Contrôler l'avancement des travaux ainsi que le respect des délais et des coûts.  
Assurer le suivi financier des chantiers.  
Élaborer les offres, les offres complémentaires et les métrés des travaux réalisés.  
Participer à la facturation et au contrôle des prestations exécutées.  
Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer le suivi des décisions prises.  
Entretenir une relation professionnelle de qualité avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, les directions de travaux et les partenaires du projet.  
Profil recherché  
Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation reconnue de conducteur(trice) de travaux.  
Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience confirmée dans la conduite de chantiers en Suisse.  
Vous disposez d'une expérience concrète dans le domaine du terrassement.  
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels ainsi que le logiciel BauBit.  
Vous êtes à l'aise dans le suivi technique, administratif et financier des chantiers.  
Vous êtes une personne proactive, autonome, organisée et dotée d'un bon sens des responsabilités.  
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer efficacement avec les différents intervenants d'un chantier.

Spa \& Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)  
ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung  
Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als

Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs\- und Fitnessräume  
Betreuen der SPA\-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich

körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.)  
gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten

Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.  
Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Senior Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Bei Accelleron kommst du weiter! Aufbauend auf der Erfolgsgeschichte von mehr als 100 Jahren ABB Turbocharging wirst du Teil eines Teams echter Expertinnen und Experten in einem spannenden internationalen Umfeld, die sich gemeinsam für Spitzenleistungen einsetzen. Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner unterstützen wir unsere Kundinnen und Kunden beim Übergang zu nachhaltigen Industrien mit innovativer Technologie, Expertise und intelligenten Lösungen.  
Wir fördern Vielfalt und Inklusion in allen Dimensionen (z. B. Geschlecht, LGBTQ\+, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Alter, Beeinträchtigung, Religion oder andere Merkmale), da wir individuelle Unterschiede begrüssen und feiern.  
Senior Payroll Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover) (m/f/d; 80\-100%; 10 months)  
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine auf 10 Monate befristete Mutterschaftsvertretung, idealerweise mit Start per 1\. November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Sie stellen eine korrekte, gesetzeskonforme und termingerechte Payroll über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sicher und fungieren als Subject Expert für Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, HR, Finance und externen Stellen beraten Sie zu payrollrelevanten Themen, treiben Prozessverbesserungen voran und stellen die erfolgreiche Durchführung von Audits sowie die Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Anforderungen sicher. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie eine umfassende Übergabe durch die aktuelle Stelleninhaberin gewährleisten einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Funktion.  
Ihre Aufgaben:  
Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.  
Hauptansprechpartner/in für externe Stakeholder (bspw. Sozialversicherungen)  
Bearbeitung und Koordination payrollrelevanter Anfragen und Tickets von Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften und HR Business Partnern.  
Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.  
Verantwortung für interne und externe Payroll\-Audits als zentrale Ansprechperson seitens HR sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten und korrekten Bereitstellung von Dokumentationen, Daten und Abstimmungen.  
Ihr Profil:  
Kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in Kombination mit einem Diplom als «HR Fachmann / Fachfrau» oder «Sozialversicherungsfachmann / Sozialversicherungsfachfrau» oder Payroll Experte.  
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Lohnverarbeitung in SAP HCM.  
Fundierte Kenntnisse im Sozialversicherungs\-, Steuer\- und Arbeitsrecht.  
Gute Kenntnisse in Workday und SAP HCM.  
Sehr gute Excel\-Kenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten für Payroll\-Reporting, Abstimmungen und Datenvalidierungen.  
Hohe Genauigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.  
Fähigkeit, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen, Verbesserungsinitiativen voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen pragmatisch umzusetzen.  
Dienstleistungsorientierte, proaktive und selbständige Arbeitsweise.  
Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.  
Ihre Benefits:  
Attraktive Vergütung.  
Kantine.  
Kinderkrippe.  
modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.  
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.  
Home\-Office\-Möglichkeiten.  
Employee Assistance Program.  
Betriebliche Sozialberatung.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
In this role, you will join Accelleron on a 10\-month maternity leave cover assignment, ideally starting on November 1, and independently manage Swiss payroll operations for more than 1,000 employees. You will ensure accurate, compliant and timely payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle while acting as the subject expert for payroll, time \& absence, social security and tax matters. In close collaboration with employees, managers, HR, Finance and external institutions, you will provide expert guidance, drive continuous process improvements and ensure successful payroll audits and regulatory compliance. A structured onboarding and comprehensive handover from the current role holder will be provided to ensure a smooth transition into the role.  
Your Responsibilities:  
Independently execute the monthly payroll process for a workforce of over 1,000 employees in Switzerland.  
Ensure accurate and timely salary payments, payroll accounting, salary statements and year\-end activities.  
Maintain and validate payroll\-relevant employee, organizational and compensation data to ensure accurate and compliant payroll processing throughout the employee lifecycle.  
Manage payroll\-related activities within Workday, SAP and connected HR systems.  
Act as the Subject Expert for Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Social Security and Tax matters, providing expert guidance and ensuring regulatory compliance and best\-practice application.  
Serve as the primary contact for external stakeholders (e.g. social security institutions).  
Handle and coordinate payroll\-related inquiries and ticket requests from employees, managers and HR Business Partners.  
Process and reconcile payroll data, prepare payroll reports and analyses, and work closely with Finance on payroll account reconciliations, HR\-related accruals.  
Own internal and external payroll audits, acting as the key HR contact and ensuring timely and accurate delivery of required documentation, data and reconciliations.  
Your Profile:  
Commercial education or equivalent qualification combined with a diploma “HR Fachmann / Fachfrau” or “Sozialversicherungsfachmann / Sozialversicherungsfachfrau» or Payroll Expert.  
Several years of hands\-on experience in Swiss payroll processing in SAP HCM.  
Strong knowledge of Swiss social security regulations, taxation and labor law.  
Good knowledge of Workday and SAP HCM.  
Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities for payroll reporting, reconciliations and data validation.  
Strong attention to detail and high standards regarding accuracy and confidentiality.  
Strong ability to identify improvement opportunities, drive initiatives and implement process enhancements in a structured and pragmatic manner.  
Service\-oriented, proactive and able to work independently in a dynamic environment.  
Fluent in German and English.  
Your Benefits:  
Attractive compensation \& benefits.  
Canteen.  
Childcare.  
Modern office.  
Flexible Working Model.  
Employee Assistance Program.  
Inhouse Social Counselling.

Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.

jobs.title: GENOPSLAG – Administrativ pædagogisk konsulent søges til Enfamilie – 37 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
Vi genopslår stillingen og søger fortsat den rette kollega til Enfamilie.

Har du en socialfaglig forståelse, er du stærk på skrift, og trives du med at skabe struktur, kvalitet og overblik? Så kan det være dig, vi søger som vores nye administrative pædagogiske konsulent.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen og kombinerer socialfaglig kvalitetssikring med administrative og koordinerende opgaver.

Om stillingen

Som administrativ pædagogisk konsulent får du en central rolle i Enfamilies daglige arbejde. Du skal understøtte den socialfaglige kvalitet og samtidig være med til at sikre, at dokumentation, registrering, planlægning og administrative arbejdsgange fungerer i praksis.

Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med både ledelsen og vores socialfaglige konsulenter.

En væsentlig del af stillingen handler om skriftlig socialfaglig dokumentation. Du skal derfor kunne læse kritisk, formulere dig præcist og have blik for forskellen mellem konkrete observationer og faglige vurderinger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være

  • Kvalitetssikring af samværsbeskrivelser.

  • Udarbejdelse af statusrapporter på baggrund af den samlede dokumentation.

  • Udarbejdelse af underretninger på baggrund af observationer og dokumentation.

  • Kvalitetssikring af socialfaglige formuleringer, objektivitet, grammatik og sprog.

  • Planlægning og opdatering af vagter i Planday.

  • Udarbejdelse og opdatering af samværsplaner.

  • Kalenderstyring og koordinering.

  • Opdatering og dokumenthåndtering i Sofus.

  • Booking og koordinering af samværslokaler.

  • Udarbejdelse og opdatering af interne procesbeskrivelser.

  • Administrativ opfølgning på sager.

  • Koordinering mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

  • Udvikling af skabeloner og optimering af administrative arbejdsgange.

  • Diverse administrative og praktiske ad hoc-opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

Har en pædagogisk, socialfaglig eller anden relevant faglig baggrund og gerne erfaring med socialfagligt arbejde og dokumentation.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • er stærk skriftligt og kan formulere dig fagligt, præcist og professionelt

  • har forståelse for socialfaglig dokumentation

  • kan skelne mellem observationer, vurderinger og antagelser

  • har sans for detaljer uden at miste det samlede overblik

  • arbejder struktureret og systematisk

  • følger op på dine opgaver og tager ansvar for, at de bliver afsluttet

  • kan håndtere flere forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsdag

  • trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde

  • er fortrolig med IT og har let ved at lære nye systemer.

Erfaring med eksempelvis samværsbeskrivelser, statusrapporter, underretninger eller andet socialfagligt skriftligt arbejde vil være en fordel.

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

Du får en alsidig stilling, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af Enfamilies daglige drift og kvalitetssikring.

Vi arbejder med børn og familier, og derfor er faglighed, ordentlighed og kvalitet i dokumentationen afgørende for os.

Samtidig søger vi en kollega, som har lyst til at bidrage til struktur, gode arbejdsgange og et godt samarbejde i hverdagen.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen.

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til info@enfamilie.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan Enfamilie kontaktes på 22 85 98 33.

Læs mere på www.enfamilie.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi mangler en ny centerleder i Ilskov Hallen

er det dig?

Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for idræt, fællesskab og lokale aktiviteter i Ilskov? Som centerleder får du ansvaret for, at Ilskov Hallen fortsat er et velfungerende samlingspunkt for byens borgere, foreninger og gæster.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

-Drift og vedligehold: Dagligt tilsyn med hallen, rengøring, klargøring, mindre reparationer og opfølgning på fejl og mangler.

-Administration: Håndtering af bookinger, udlejning, fakturering og kontakt til brugere og foreninger.

-Udendørs og praktiske opgaver: Ansvar for udearealer og løbende vedligehold.

-Arrangementer: Planlægning, koordinering og afvikling af arrangementer i Ilskov Hallen.

-Samarbejde: Tæt samarbejde med halbestyrelsen, foreningerne, skolen, daginstitutionen og øvrige brugere af hallen.

 

Vi forventer

-Du er imødekommende, serviceminded og god til mennesker.

-Du arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt.

-Du kan planlægge og strukturere din egen arbejdsuge. Som udgangspunkt fordeles arbejdstiden på hverdage fra mandag til fredag, men der kan forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde i forbindelse med arrangementer og aktiviteter.

-Du trives i mødet med mennesker i alle aldre – fra de yngste brugere til de ældre – og møder alle med et smil og god service.

-Du behersker dansk i skrift og tale.

-Du har almindelige IT-færdigheder og er fortrolig med at arbejde på computer. Vi bruger Conventus til bookinger, men kendskab til systemet er ikke en forudsætning – du vil naturligvis blive oplært. Kontrakter og fakturering foregår ligeledes digitalt.

 

Vi tilbyder

-Et tæt samarbejde med halbestyrelsen og foreningerne i Ilskov.

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions.

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs.
